Keep your ribs down and brace your core. Finish the reps, then switch arms.
Hold a dumbbell at your chest and picture a clock on the floor around you.
Step to 12 o'clock and squat down with your chest up.
Stand up and return to the center.
Step to the next position on the clock and squat again.
Work your way around the clock with control and switch direction on the next set.
Stand with feet wider than shoulders and a kettlebell in both hands.
Hinge at the hips and swing the bell back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and swing the bell up toward chest height, angled to one side.
Let it swing back down with a flat back.
Finish the reps on one side, then switch.
Stand behind a loaded sled and drop into a burpee, chest to the floor.
Jump up to your feet explosively.
Grab the sled handles with your arms extended and lean in.
Drive with short, powerful steps to push the sled for a set distance.
Return and repeat, keeping your back flat while pushing.
Sit with the soles of your feet together and knees open.
Hold your feet or ankles.
Roll back slowly along your spine.
Roll forward to sit up again.
Repeat smoothly for 8 to 10 reps.
Kneel on one knee holding one end of a barbell in a landmine setup near your hip.
Brace your core and stay tall.
Lift the bar diagonally across your body and up toward the opposite shoulder.
Return the bar slowly to the start.
Keep your hips square. Finish the reps, then switch sides.
Stand with a light dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Do a set of lateral raises, then straight into front raises.
Move into a set of overhead presses without putting the weights down.
Lower the dumbbells under control and rest.
Keep the weights light and your torso still throughout.
Stand sideways to a wall or rebound surface holding a medicine ball at chest height.
Wind the ball slightly away from the target.
Rotate and throw the ball hard against the wall with both hands.
Catch it, reset your stance and go again.
Use your hips and keep your core tight. Finish the reps, then switch sides.

exercises.exerciseName: sled alternating single leg negative press

instructions.originalText: Sit in the sled with feet on the platform and release the safety.
Press the platform up with both legs and lock out gently.
Shift the load to one leg and lower it slowly for 3-4 seconds.
Press back up with both legs.
Alternate the lowering leg each rep and never let your lower back round.
Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand with a soft bend in the knees.
Push your hips back and lower the weights down your legs.
Reach one dumbbell across toward the opposite foot, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Alternate the crossing side each rep.
Anchor a band overhead and kneel or stand beside it.
Hold the band at your shoulder with the near hand.
Bend sideways toward your hip.
Return to upright under control.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
Kneel tall holding a dumbbell by one end at chest level.
Circle the dumbbell around your head, keeping it close.
Keep your ribs down and your hips still.
Complete the circle back to the front.
Do a few reps one way, then reverse direction.
Loop a band around your ankles or one ankle and anchor it.
Stand tall and hold a support if needed.
Lift one straight leg forward to hip height.
Lower slowly.
Complete reps, then switch legs.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place the band under your feet.
Hold the band handles with your palms facing each other and your arms extended in front of you.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Pull the band towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly release the tension and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.exerciseName: band straight back stiff leg deadlift

instructions.originalText: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place the band around your upper legs.
Hold the band with both hands in front of your thighs, palms facing your body.
Keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent, hinge at the hips and lower the band towards the ground.
Feel the stretch in your hamstrings as you lower the band.
Engage your glutes and hamstrings to lift your body back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Sit on the machine and place one foot on the platform.
Release the safety and lower the platform until your knee is bent about 90 degrees.
Press through your heel to straighten the leg without locking the knee.
Lower back with control.
Keep your hips on the seat. Finish the reps, then switch legs.
Set the assistance and stand on the pad holding the handles.
Keep your elbows close and your chest up.
Lower your body by bending the elbows until they are at 90 degrees.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Avoid shrugging your shoulders and move smoothly.
Adjust the seat so the handles are at mid-chest height and sit back.
Grip the handles with your elbows slightly below shoulder level.
Press the handles forward until your arms are almost straight.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch in the chest.
Keep your back against the pad.
Stand tall with arms relaxed at your sides.
Lift your toes and forefoot off the floor so you balance on your heels.
Walk forward with small, controlled steps.
Keep your toes pulled up the whole time.
Walk for 20-30 seconds, then rest.
Sit on the pec deck with your back flat and the arms at chest level.
Place your forearms or hands on the pads with elbows slightly bent.
Bring the arms together in front of your chest.
Squeeze for a moment, then open slowly until you feel a chest stretch.
Keep your shoulders down and back.
Stand facing the machine and rest your hands on the support.
Place the back of your working leg against the lever pad.
Push the leg back and slightly up by squeezing the glute.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your torso upright without arching your back. Finish the reps, then switch legs.
Sit with your upper arms resting on the pad and grab the handles.
Curl one handle up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower it slowly while curling the other arm.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and avoid swinging.
Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Jump both feet forward, landing outside your hands in a wide squat.
Stand or hop up briefly if you like, then lower your hands.
Jump your feet back to the plank.
Keep a tight core and land softly.
Sit on the floor with knees bent and lean back slightly.
Hold a kettlebell at your chest with both hands.
Rotate your torso to bring the bell beside one hip.
Rotate to the other side in a smooth motion.
Keep your chest lifted and feet raised for more challenge.
Set up in the belt squat machine and place your back foot on the bench behind you.
Stand tall with the front foot far enough forward.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is parallel.
Press through the front heel to stand.
Keep your torso upright. Finish the reps, then switch legs.
Stand beside a bench with one hand and knee supported on it and hold a heavy dumbbell.
Let the weight hang with a stretch in the lat.
Row the dumbbell to your hip using controlled momentum.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.
Keep your back flat. Finish the reps, then switch arms.
Sit and adjust the seat so your upper arms rest on the pad.
Grab the handles with your elbows bent.
Press the handles down until your arms are straight.
Squeeze the triceps for a second.
Return slowly without lifting your shoulders.
Lie on your side on a bench holding a light dumbbell in your top hand.
Start with the arm hanging in front of your body.
Raise the arm out and back in an arc until it is in line with your torso.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
Use a light weight and switch sides after your set.

exercises.exerciseName: resistance band weighted standing pronation twist curl (arm wrestler)

instructions.originalText: Stand on a resistance band and hold the handle with your palm turned to the side.
Curl the handle up while rotating your wrist.
Finish with your palm facing you and the biceps squeezed.
Lower slowly and untwist back to the start.
Keep your elbow tucked. Finish the reps, then switch arms.
Stand next to the machine and place the outer side of your leg against the pad.
Hold the support for balance.
Push your leg out to the side in a smooth motion.
Pause briefly, then return slowly.
Keep your torso upright. Finish the reps, then switch legs.
Lie face down with arms extended in front.
Lift your arms, chest and legs a few inches.
Pulse them up and down in small movements.
Keep your neck neutral.
Lower and rest after your set.
Stand next to the machine with the inner side of your leg against the pad.
Hold the support for balance.
Pull your leg across your body, squeezing your inner thigh.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your hips level and avoid leaning. Finish the reps, then switch legs.
Stand facing the machine with your hands on the support.
Place the front of your thigh against the pad.
Raise your leg forward until the thigh is about parallel with the floor.
Lower slowly to the start.
Keep your torso tall. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.exerciseName: resistance band sitting floor tibialis press

instructions.originalText: Sit on the floor with your legs out and loop a band around your foot, anchored in front.
Keep your leg straight and your heel on the floor.
Pull your toes up toward your shin against the band.
Hold briefly, then slowly release.
Do all reps on one foot, then switch.
Sit on a bench or box with a kettlebell hanging from the top of one foot.
Plant your heel on the floor.
Lift the toes up toward your shin to raise the kettlebell.
Pause, then lower slowly.
Use a light weight. Finish the reps, then switch feet.
Stand facing the machine and hold the handles for support.
Place the back of your working leg against the pad.
Kick the leg back by squeezing the glute.
Pause at the top, then return slowly.
Keep your torso upright. Finish the reps, then switch legs.
Position yourself in the machine with the pads on your shoulders and feet shoulder width apart.
Release the safety and brace your core.
Bend your knees and sit back and down.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Stand over a sandbag with feet hip width apart.
Hinge at your hips, bend your knees and grip the bag.
Brace your core and drive through your feet to stand tall with the bag.
Push your hips back and lower the bag to the floor.
Keep your back flat throughout.
Hold a sandbag in a bear hug against your chest.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Sit back and down into a squat with your chest up.
Drive through your heels to stand up.
Keep the bag tight to your body.
Stand over a sandbag and grip it firmly with both hands.
Lift the bag, driving through your legs and hips.
Pull it to your lap, then heave it up onto one shoulder.
Lower it to the floor with control.
Alternate shoulders each rep.
Lift the sandbag onto your shoulders and hold it there.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Walk forward with steady, controlled steps.
Keep your ribs stacked over your hips.
Carry for a set distance or time, then set the bag down carefully.
Lift the sandbag and hug it against your chest.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Walk forward with steady steps.
Keep your arms squeezing the bag tight.
Carry for a set distance or time, then lower the bag with care.
Hold a sandbag at your upper chest or shoulders.
Stand with feet hip width apart and brace your core.
Press the bag straight overhead.
Lock out the arms, then lower the bag with control.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.
Stand over a sandbag, hinge forward and grab it with both hands.
Keep your back flat and knees slightly bent.
Row the bag toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly back to full arm extension.
Step into the machine with the pads on your shoulders and feet shoulder width apart.
Release the safety and brace your core.
Squat as deep as you comfortably can.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Keep your chest up and knees over your toes.
Step into the machine and put one foot on the platform with the other leg lifted or extended.
Brace your core and release the safety.
Lower slowly into a deep squat on one leg.
Press through your heel to stand.
Keep your knee in line with your toes. Finish the reps, then switch legs.
Lie back on the machine bench and grip the handles at chest level.
Plant your feet and keep your shoulders pulled back.
Press the handles up until your arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly until you feel a stretch in the chest.
Keep your back on the pad throughout.
Rest the mace on your shoulders and hold it with both hands.
Stand with feet about shoulder width apart.
Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your chest tall and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your feet to stand back up.
Stand tall with feet shoulder width apart and hold the mace upright near your chest.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.
Circle the mace around your head in a smooth, controlled arc.
Keep your elbows close and your head still.
Do all reps, then reverse the direction.
Lie face down on a bench with your head past the edge and a light weight on the back of your head.
Start with your chin tucked toward your chest.
Slowly lift your head until your neck is in line with your torso.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
Keep the load light and the motion smooth.
Stand over the sandbag with feet shoulder width apart.
Hinge down, grip the bag and keep your back flat.
Drive your hips forward and pull the bag up the front of your body.
Extend fully and throw the bag back over your shoulder.
Reset and repeat, facing the same way.
Lie on your back on a bench with your head past the edge and a light weight on your forehead.
Hold the weight with a hand for control.
Slowly curl your head up, tucking your chin.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
Keep the load light and avoid jerking.

exercises.exerciseName: cable single arm low row (with rope)

instructions.originalText: Attach a rope to a low pulley and sit facing the stack with your feet braced.
Hold the rope in one hand with your arm extended.
Pull your elbow back along your side, squeezing your shoulder blade.
Pause, then let the arm extend slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
Grab a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands about shoulder width apart.
Hang with your arms long and your body relaxed.
Shift your weight toward one hand, letting that side stretch.
Shift to the other side and keep alternating.
Hold the hang for 20-30 seconds in total.
Grab one rope in each hand and hang with arms long.
Pull up with one arm while you bend your elbow close to your body.
Reach higher with the other hand and pull again.
Keep your core tight and your legs steady.
Climb to a safe height, then lower under control.
Pick up two smooth plates and stack them with the smooth sides facing out.
Pinch them together with your fingertips and thumb.
Stand tall with your arm hanging by your side.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without letting the plates slip.
Switch hands and repeat.

exercises.exerciseName: barbell seated military press (inside squat cage)

instructions.originalText: Set a bench inside the cage and the bar at shoulder height.
Sit tall, grip the bar just outside shoulder width and unrack it.
Press the bar straight overhead until your arms are extended.
Lower it to your upper chest with control.
Keep your ribs down and your back against the pad.
Set a cable handle at about head height and take a stable stance.
Grab the handle and lean back slightly with arms extended.
Pull toward your upper chest, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.exerciseName: seated hamstring stretch on a chair

instructions.originalText: Sit near the front edge of a chair.
Extend one leg straight with your heel on the floor and toes up.
Hinge forward from your hips with a flat back until you feel a stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Switch legs and repeat.

exercises.exerciseName: seated squeeze shoulder blades chest stretch on a chair

instructions.originalText: Sit tall on a chair with your feet flat.
Reach your hands behind you and clasp them or hold the chair back.
Pull your shoulder blades together and lift your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without arching your lower back.
Relax and repeat.

exercises.exerciseName: cable close grip front lat pulldown

instructions.originalText: Sit at the pulldown station and secure your thighs under the pads.
Grab the bar with a close grip.
Lean back slightly and pull the bar down to your upper chest.
Drive your elbows down and squeeze your lats.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.exerciseName: dumbbell lying one arm rear lateral raise v. 2

instructions.originalText: Lie on your side on a bench holding a light dumbbell in your top hand.
Start with your arm hanging in front of you, slight bend in the elbow.
Raise the arm out and up until it is about shoulder height.
Pause, then lower with control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
Place your hands on a bench and step back into a hinged position.
Keep your back flat and your core braced.
Kick one leg straight back and up, squeezing your glute.
Lower without letting your hips rotate.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
Place a block under the Smith bar and rest the bar on your upper back.
Stand with the balls of your feet on the block.
Lower your heels for a full stretch.
Rise onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

exercises.exerciseName: cable reverse narrow grip lat pulldown

instructions.originalText: Sit at the pulldown station and secure your thighs.
Grab the bar with a narrow underhand grip.
Lean back a little and pull the bar to your upper chest.
Keep your elbows close to your sides.
Return slowly until your arms are fully extended.
Start on hands and knees with hands under shoulders.
Tuck your chin and round your back toward the ceiling.
Draw your belly button in and hold for a few breaths.
Return to a neutral spine.
Repeat slowly, holding the rounded position 15-20 seconds.

exercises.exerciseName: standing single leg hip swirl with chair support

instructions.originalText: Stand beside a chair and hold it for balance.
Lift one leg slightly off the floor.
Draw slow, controlled circles with your leg.
Do half of the reps one way, then reverse the direction.
Switch legs and repeat.
Grip a fixed bar or post at about hip height.
Step back until your arms are straight.
Sink your hips back and let your chest drop.
Feel the stretch along your back and sides.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward in a lunge.
Tuck your pelvis under and squeeze your back glute.
Shift your hips forward gently.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, keeping your torso tall.
Switch sides and repeat.
Sit on a chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Slide one foot back under the chair, bending the knee.
Pause briefly at the end of the range.
Return the foot slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
Sit with one foot resting flat and the other leg crossed over it.
Hook the toes of the lower foot under your other foot for light resistance.
Lift the toes and forefoot up toward your shin.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch feet.

exercises.exerciseName: resistance band standing single leg knee extension

instructions.originalText: Anchor a band behind you and loop it around one ankle or behind the knee.
Stand tall and hold on for balance if needed.
Straighten your knee against the band.
Pause with the leg extended.
Bend slowly back, then switch legs after your reps.
Sit tall on a chair with your feet flat.
Slowly straighten one knee to lift your foot.
Squeeze your thigh at the top for a second.
Lower the foot back to the floor with control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.exerciseName: seated single leg knee extension v. 2

instructions.originalText: Sit tall on a chair, holding the seat edge for support.
Straighten one knee until the leg is level.
Hold for a second, tightening your thigh.
Lower slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.exerciseName: weighted seated single leg knee extension v. 2

instructions.originalText: Strap a light ankle weight on and sit tall on a chair.
Hold the seat edge for support.
Straighten the knee until your leg is level.
Hold for a second and squeeze your thigh.
Lower slowly, then switch legs after your reps.
Step into a lunge with hands on a wall or knee.
Keep the back leg straight with heel down.
Lean forward until you feel a stretch.
Keep your foot pointing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Slide one foot under the other for light resistance.
Lift the toes of the lower foot toward your shin.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch feet.

exercises.exerciseName: seated single leg hugging knee flexion

instructions.originalText: Sit tall on a chair with feet flat.
Lift one knee and clasp your hands around the shin.
Gently pull the knee toward your chest and flex it.
Hold for a moment, then release.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.exerciseName: seated single leg hugging knee flexion with towel

instructions.originalText: Sit tall on a chair and loop a towel around one shin.
Hold the towel ends with both hands.
Pull the knee gently toward your chest, bending it.
Hold for a moment, then release.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
Hold the back of a chair and kneel on one knee on a soft surface.
Keep your torso upright.
Slowly sit back toward your heel to bend the knee.
Stay within a comfortable range.
Return to the start and switch sides after your reps.
Stand on one leg next to a wall for balance.
Rock your weight back onto your heel, lifting the toes.
Roll forward onto the ball of your foot.
Keep the movement smooth and controlled.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.exerciseName: standing single leg concentration calf raise

instructions.originalText: Stand on one leg and hold a wall or rail lightly.
Lower your heel slightly for a stretch.
Rise high onto your toes, squeezing the calf.
Pause for a second at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.
Lie on your back with one foot raised on a bench or step.
Extend the other leg straight up.
Drive through your heel and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching your back.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.
Lie on your back holding a plate between your palms at your chest.
Squeeze the plate firmly.
Press it straight up until your arms are extended.
Keep squeezing as you lower it back to your chest.
Repeat with steady control.
Stand with feet slightly wider than your shoulders.
Squat down as deep as is comfortable.
Press your elbows against your knees and keep your chest up.
Rock gently side to side.
Stay for 20-30 seconds, then stand.

exercises.exerciseName: medicine ball split stance torso twist

instructions.originalText: Stand in a split stance and hold a medicine ball at chest height.
Brace your core.
Rotate your torso to one side, keeping your hips steady.
Return to the centre and rotate the other way.
Complete all reps, then switch the front foot.
Anchor a band overhead and hold the handles with both hands.
Stand with a staggered stance and your arms raised.
Pull the handles down and forward in a controlled hit.
Brace your core as you finish.
Return slowly and repeat.
Start in a straight-arm plank with a ball in front of you.
Tighten your core and glutes.
Lift one hand and tap the ball.
Return the hand and tap with the other.
Keep your hips as still as possible.

exercises.exerciseName: seated neck flexion to extension on chair

instructions.originalText: Sit tall on a chair with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly lower your chin toward your chest.
Gently lift your head and look slightly upward.
Keep the motion smooth and pain free.
Repeat for several slow reps.

exercises.exerciseName: seated side to side neck twist on chair

instructions.originalText: Sit tall on a chair with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly turn your head to look over one shoulder.
Return to the centre.
Turn to the other side.
Repeat for several slow reps.

exercises.exerciseName: seated side to side neck bend on chair

instructions.originalText: Sit tall on a chair with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly tilt your head so your ear moves toward one shoulder.
Return to the centre.
Tilt toward the other shoulder.
Repeat for several slow reps.
Lie on your back with knees bent, holding a medicine ball overhead.
Sit up in one motion, bringing the ball forward.
Slam the ball down in front of your feet.
Catch it on the bounce or pick it up.
Lie back with control and repeat.
Stand tall holding a dumbbell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Raise it straight up in front of you to overhead.
Control it at the top and keep your core braced.
Lower it slowly back down.
Use a moderate weight and avoid arching your back.
Lie on your back.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Pull the bottom leg toward your chest.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
Lie on a bench with a spotter or safety pins set.
Unrack the bar over your chest.
Lower the bar toward your chest under control.
Stop it just above the chest and press up.
Keep your feet planted and your shoulder blades pinched.
Stand on one leg holding a kettlebell in one hand.
Hinge at the hips and reach the bell toward the floor.
Pass the bell to the other hand below your knee.
Stand back up using your glute and hamstring.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.exerciseName: kettlebell ipsilateral reverse lunge high knee

instructions.originalText: Hold a kettlebell in one hand and stand tall.
Step back with the leg on the same side as the bell.
Lower into a lunge.
Drive up and lift that knee high as you stand.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
Place a foot flat a short distance from a box or step.
Keep your heel down.
Push your knee forward to touch the box.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a calf stretch.
Switch legs and repeat.
Sit on a chair with one foot lifted slightly off the floor.
Roll the sole of your foot inward.
Roll it outward as far as is comfortable.
Keep the lower leg still.
Finish your reps, then switch feet.
Sit on the floor with both knees bent at 90 degrees, one leg in front, one to the side.
Sit tall.
Hinge forward over the front shin with a flat back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides and repeat.
Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward.
Hold your arms crossed in front of your chest.
Rotate your upper body toward the front leg.
Return to the centre and keep your hips square.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
Stand next to a wall or door frame.
Place your forearm or hand on the wall at shoulder height.
Slowly turn your body away from the arm.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch arms and repeat.
Lie on a bench holding a barbell at arm's length over your thighs.
Keep your arms straight with a soft elbow.
Raise the bar in an arc until it is above your chest.
Lower it slowly back down.
Use a light weight and keep your back flat.
Lie on your back holding a stick with an overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight.
Raise the stick overhead as far as is comfortable.
Return to your thighs slowly.
Keep your ribs down throughout.
Stand tall and hold something for balance if needed.
Bend one knee and grab your ankle.
Pull your heel toward your glute, knees together.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.
Stand and hinge forward to place your hands on the floor.
Walk your hands out in front of you.
Sit your hips back and press your chest down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Walk your hands back in and stand up.

exercises.exerciseName: resistance band seated single leg hugging knee flexion

instructions.originalText: Sit tall on a chair with a band around one foot.
Hold the band ends in your hands.
Pull the knee up and bend it toward your chest.
Hold for a moment, then release slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
Kneel on one knee with the other leg extended, heel on the floor.
Keep your toes pointing up.
Hinge forward from your hips with a flat back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.
Place your hands on a bench in an incline plank.
Brace your core and keep your body straight.
Jump your feet wide.
Jump them back together.
Keep your hips level and the pace steady.
Anchor the band at chest height beside you and hold the handle at your chest.
Stand tall in a stable stance with your core braced.
Press the handle forward and across your body in a quick controlled motion.
Return slowly to your chest without letting the band pull you around.
Keep your hips square throughout.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
Lie on your back with knees bent, holding a medicine ball overhead.
Pull the ball forward over your chest to throw it up toward a partner or wall.
Catch the ball with soft elbows as it returns.
Let it travel back overhead in a controlled arc.
Keep your lower back pressed to the floor.
Repeat at a steady rhythm.
Set the cable at shoulder height and stand sideways to it.
Raise your upper arm out to the side with the elbow bent 90 degrees.
Let the cable pull your forearm back into external rotation.
Catch it, then rotate the forearm forward and down smoothly.
Keep your upper arm still and level.
Complete the reps, then switch arms.

exercises.exerciseName: medicine ball lying floor close press catch

instructions.originalText: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding a medicine ball above your chest.
Press the ball up quickly with your hands close together.
Catch it as it comes down with soft elbows.
Lower it to just above your chest.
Keep your back flat and ribs down.
Repeat for controlled, crisp reps.
Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and a padded barbell over your hips.
Plant your feet hip-width apart and drive through your heels.
Lift your hips until your torso is level with the floor.
Squeeze your glutes at the top and keep your chin tucked.
Lower your hips under control.
Repeat without arching your lower back.
Set your upper back on a bench with a padded barbell over your hips.
Extend one leg or hold it bent in the air.
Drive through the planted heel to lift your hips level.
Squeeze your glute at the top without twisting.
Lower under control.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.
Rest your upper back on a bench and place the weight on your hips.
Plant one foot and lift the other leg off the floor.
Push through your heel to raise your hips until your torso is level.
Pause and squeeze your glute.
Lower slowly.
Complete the reps, then change legs.
Set the bar on your upper back and stand with feet well wider than your shoulders.
Turn your toes out about 30 degrees.

exercises.exerciseName: resistance band assisted single arm pull up v. 2

Grip the bar with one hand and keep the other arm across your chest.

Lower under control. Finish your reps and switch arms.

Step one foot far forward and the other back into a split stance.

Switch legs.

exercises.exerciseName: bodyweight single leg deadlift toe touch

instructions.originalText: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Hinge forward as the free leg lifts behind you.
Reach your hands toward the toes of the standing foot.
Keep your back flat and hips square.
Stand back up with control. Finish your reps and switch legs.

exercises.exerciseName: seated single leg tibialis press v. 2

instructions.originalText: Sit on a chair with one foot flat and the other crossed over it.
Press the top foot up against the resistance of the bottom foot.
Feel the front of your shin work.
Hold for a second.
Relax and repeat, then switch feet.

exercises.exerciseName: seated single leg squeezing toes v. 2

instructions.originalText: Sit with one foot flat on the floor.
Curl your toes down and hold the squeeze.
Keep your heel planted.
Release and spread your toes.
Do all reps, then switch feet.

exercises.exerciseName: seated single leg foot side to side v. 2

instructions.originalText: Sit tall and lift one foot a little off the floor.
Keep your leg still.
Sweep the foot to the inside, then to the outside.
Keep the motion smooth and pain free.
Repeat, then switch feet.

exercises.exerciseName: resistance band seated single leg knee extension hold

instructions.originalText: Sit on a chair with a band anchored around one ankle behind you.

Keep the thigh tight and your back upright.
Lower slowly and switch legs.

exercises.exerciseName: standing wall slide quarter squat hold

instructions.originalText: Stand with your back against a wall and feet slightly forward.
Slide down until your knees bend about a quarter of the way.
Keep your back flat to the wall.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.

exercises.exerciseName: standing forward slide press with towel

instructions.originalText: Stand facing a wall and place a towel under your hand against it.
Keep your elbow bent and the hand at chest height.

Slide it back slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.exerciseName: standing wall serratus slide with towel

instructions.originalText: Stand facing a wall with a towel under your forearm on the wall.
Keep your elbow bent and your body upright.

exercises.exerciseName: standing internal rotation slide with towel

exercises.exerciseName: standing external rotation slide with towel

Slide your hand outward along the wall.
Return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.exerciseName: standing external rotation behind back with towel

instructions.originalText: Stand tall holding a towel behind your back with both hands.
Keep the lower hand still and pull the upper hand away.
Rotate the upper shoulder outward.
Hold briefly and release.
Finish your reps, then switch hands.

exercises.exerciseName: shoulder stretch behind the back with towel

exercises.exerciseName: bodyweight side lying shoulder external rotation

exercises.exerciseName: cable lying alternating bent leg jackknife v. 3

instructions.originalText: Lie on your back with your feet attached to a low cable and hands by your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Bring one bent knee toward your chest.
Lower it slowly and switch legs.
Keep a controlled alternating rhythm.

exercises.exerciseName: cable single arm row with rotation v. 3

instructions.originalText: Stand facing a cable at chest height with a single handle in one hand.
Take a staggered stance and brace your core.
Row the handle to your ribs while rotating your torso slightly.
Squeeze your back at the end.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.
Set an incline bench between two low pulleys and hold a handle in each hand.
Plant your feet and pull your shoulder blades back.
Press the handles up and slightly together.
Squeeze your upper chest at the top.
Lower slowly to a comfortable stretch.
Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley, face away from the machine, and hold on for balance.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Drive your working knee forward and up.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.
Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley on the near side and hold something for balance.
Stand tall with your core tight.
Lift your outside leg out to the side.
Pause at the top without leaning.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.
Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley on the far side and hold something for balance.
Stand tall with your core tight.
Sweep your working leg across in front of the other leg.
Squeeze your inner thigh.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.
Hold a cable handle at your chest and stand with feet shoulder width.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit down and back until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand.

exercises.exerciseName: cable bent over single arm row v. 3

instructions.originalText: Face a low pulley, hinge forward with a flat back and hold the handle.
Brace your core and keep your hips back.
Row the handle toward your hip.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.
Hold the handles overhead and hang with arms straight.
Brace your core.
Pull your chest up toward the handles, elbows down.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower slowly to full extension.
Bend your knees or lean back to make it easier.
Kneel under a high pulley and hold the rope beside your head.
Keep your hips still.
Curl your torso down, bringing elbows toward your knees.
Squeeze your abs at the bottom.
Return slowly to the upright start.
Stand side-on to a cable set at chest height and hold the handle with both hands.
Keep your arms straight and feet planted.
Rotate your torso away from the machine.
Pause, then return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.exerciseName: cable standing biceps curl to arnold press v. 3

instructions.originalText: Hold low cable handles, palms forward, arms down.
Curl the handles up to your shoulders.
Rotate your palms inward as you start to press.
Press overhead, turning your palms forward.
Reverse the move and lower under control.
Lie on a bench between two low pulleys and hold a handle in each hand over your chest.
Keep a soft bend in your elbows.
Lower your arms out to the sides in a wide arc.
Stop at a comfortable stretch.
Bring the handles back together over your chest.

exercises.exerciseName: cable standing alternating diagonal chest press v. 3

instructions.originalText: Stand in a staggered stance holding a high cable handle in each hand.
Brace your core.
Press one handle forward and down diagonally.
Return slowly and press with the other arm.
Alternate for the set without twisting your hips.
Set up in a side plank with a low cable handle in your top hand.
Lift your hips so your body is in a straight line.
Row the handle toward your ribs.
Keep your hips high and stable.
Extend slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.exerciseName: cable prone single leg curl v. 3

instructions.originalText: Lie face down with an ankle strap attached to a low cable.
Keep your hips pressed down.
Curl your heel toward your glutes.
Squeeze your hamstring at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.
Stand facing away from a low pulley, holding the handle between your legs.
Keep your core tight and arm nearly straight.
Raise the handle forward to shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.
Stand side-on to a low pulley and hold the handle at your side.
Keep your chest tall.
Bend sideways away from the machine.
Contract your obliques to return upright.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.exerciseName: cable standing single arm overhead triceps extension v. 3

instructions.originalText: Hold a handle from a low pulley overhead, elbow bent, with your upper arm close to your head.
Brace your core.
Straighten your arm overhead.
Squeeze your triceps at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.
Hold the handles and get into a plank with hands under shoulders.
Keep your body in one line.
Lower your chest between the handles.
Keep the straps steady and elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press up to straight arms.
Do not let the hips sag.

exercises.exerciseName: glute ham developer straight arms sit up

instructions.originalText: Set up on the GHD with your feet secured and hips on the pad.
Extend your arms overhead and lean back.
Curl up, bringing your arms forward.
Reach your torso over your knees.
Lower slowly with control.
Stand tall with feet shoulder width apart.
Jump up and pull your knees toward your chest.
Cross your feet in the air.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Uncross on the next jump, alternating the crossing foot.
Keep a steady quick rhythm.
Lie on your back holding a kettlebell over your chest in one hand.
Keep a soft bend in your elbow.
Lower the kettlebell out to the side in an arc.
Bring it back over your chest.
Switch hands and alternate.

exercises.exerciseName: resistance band lying floor chest press

instructions.originalText: Lie on your back with the band under your upper back and a handle in each hand.
Start with your hands at chest level.
Press your hands straight up until your arms extend.
Squeeze your chest.
Lower slowly back to the start.
Start in a half kneeling position holding a kettlebell at your chest.
Straighten the front leg to the side as you shift your weight back.
Feel a stretch in your inner thigh.
Return to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.exerciseName: kettlebell standing behind back romanian deadlift

instructions.originalText: Hold a kettlebell behind your back in both hands, feet hip width.
Soften your knees and brace your core.
Push your hips back and hinge forward with a flat back.
Stop when you feel your hamstrings stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Stand tall and raise your arms straight overhead.
Keep your ribs down and core tight.
Shrug your shoulders up toward your ears.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly and repeat.
Stand tall with your feet hip width.
Shift your weight onto one foot.
Rotate your ankle and hip through a smooth circle.
Keep your upper body steady.
Do 8-10 slow reps, then switch sides.
Hold the handles and stand tall, facing the anchor.
Step one leg back and lower into a lunge.
Keep your front knee above the ankle.
Press through the front heel to return.
Use the straps for balance only.
Alternate legs or finish one side first.
Hold the handles and lean back with arms straight in front.
Keep your body in a line.
Open your arms wide, pulling the shoulder blades together.
Keep arms slightly bent and level with the shoulders.
Return slowly to the start.
Walk your feet forward to lighten the load.
Set a bench behind you and place the bar on your upper back.
Unrack and step your feet slightly forward.
Sit down until you lightly touch the bench.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand.

exercises.exerciseName: lever single arm reverse grip lateral pulldown (plate loaded)

instructions.originalText: Sit in the machine and grab one handle with an underhand grip.
Sit tall and brace your core.
Pull the handle down, driving your elbow toward your side.
Squeeze your lat at the bottom.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.
Hold the handles and stand tall.
Step one leg out and slightly behind the other, crossing the body.
Sink back into the hip with a flat back.
Push through the working foot to return.
Keep your knee in line with your toes.
Switch sides after your reps.

exercises.exerciseName: incline close grip push up with chair against wall

instructions.originalText: Brace a chair against a wall and place your hands close together on the seat.
Walk your feet back until your body is in a straight line.
Lower your chest toward the chair, elbows close to your body.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips in line.
Stand with your back against a wall and your feet slightly forward.
Slide down until your knees are bent to about 45 degrees.
Keep your back flat on the wall.
Press through your heels to rise.
Repeat for the set.
Set up on a hyperextension bench with your feet secured and hold a plate against your chest.
Keep your back straight and body in a line.
Lower your torso with control.
Raise until you are back in a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top without overarching.
Hold the handles and stand with feet together.
Step out wide to one side.
Bend that knee and push your hips back, keeping the other leg straight.
Keep your chest up and heel down.
Push off to return to the start.
Alternate sides.

exercises.exerciseName: suspender single arm rear delt row

instructions.originalText: Hold one handle and lean back at an angle.
Keep your hips level and free hand on your chest or hip.
Pull the handle toward your shoulder with the elbow flared out.
Squeeze the rear delt at the end.
Lower slowly to a straight arm.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.exerciseName: suspender single leg plank straight arm

instructions.originalText: Put your feet in the straps and set a high plank.
Lift one leg slightly higher.
Keep your hips level and body straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower the leg and switch sides.
Breathe steadily throughout.
Place your feet in the straps and rest on your forearms.
Lift one leg a bit higher than the other.
Keep your hips square and abs tight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower and switch legs.
Do not let the lower back arch.
Hold the handles and stand on one leg, other leg forward.
Sit your hips back and bend the knee.
Lower as far as you can control.
Keep your knee over your toes and chest tall.
Drive through the heel to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
Lie on your back with your feet in the straps and knees bent.
Place your hands by your head or across your chest.
Curl your torso up toward your knees.
Squeeze the abs at the top.
Lower back down slowly.

Keep your shoulder stacked and the upper arm at chest height.

Press up and extend the leg back.
Alternate sides each rep.
Keep your hips low and steady.
Extend one arm in front of you with the elbow straight and palm facing down.
Bend the wrist so your fingers point toward the floor.
With your other hand, gently pull the back of the hand toward you.
Keep the stretch mild and your shoulder relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.
Hold the handles and step into a split stance leaning forward.
Keep arms slightly bent and hands in front of you.
Open your arms out wide to the sides.
Squeeze at the end of the stretch without shrugging.
Bring the arms back together under control.
Switch the lead leg halfway through.
Hold the handles and lean slightly forward.
Stand on one leg with the other knee raised.
Drive one knee up as the opposite arm moves.
Switch legs with a quick hop.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Keep your core tight and pace steady.
Hold the handles overhead with arms straight.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Sit back and down into a squat.
Keep your arms up and chest tall.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Do not let the lower back round.
Hold the handles with arms extended.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Sit your hips back and bend your knees.
Lower until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Push through the heels to stand.
Keep your chest tall and knees tracking over toes.

exercises.exerciseName: cable standing neutral grip overhead triceps extension

instructions.originalText: Attach a rope or neutral handle to a low pulley and face away from the stack.
Hold it overhead with elbows bent and pointing forward, one foot slightly ahead.
Keep your upper arms close to your ears and your ribs down.
Extend your elbows until your arms are straight overhead.
Lower slowly back to a deep stretch and repeat.

Pull back to the start with your abs.
Take a smaller range if you need.
Put your feet in the straps and set a high plank.
Spread your legs wide.
Keep your hips level and body straight.
Brace the abs.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Breathe steadily and do not sag.
Stand facing the stairs with your feet hip-width apart.
Place one foot on the first step and push through the heel to climb up.
Continue onto the second step, then step back down in control.
Keep your torso tall and your knee tracking over your toes.
Alternate the leading leg each rep or finish all reps on one side first.

exercises.exerciseName: standing wall slide half squat hold

instructions.originalText: Stand with your back against a wall and feet about a step in front of you.
Slide down until your knees are bent to about 45-60 degrees.
Keep your back flat on the wall and your knees over your ankles.
Press through your whole foot and breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-45 seconds, then slide back up.
Stand facing a wall and place your hands on it at chest height.
Step one foot back with the heel flat on the floor and the toes pointing forward.
Bend the front knee and lean in until you feel the back calf stretch.
Keep the back leg straight and the heel down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.
Place your feet in the straps spread wide in a high plank.

Lower your chest toward the floor.
Keep elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up.
Hold the wide leg position the whole set.
Lie on your back with your feet in the straps and legs up.

Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower slowly to the start.
Do not swing the legs.

Squeeze your glutes and keep abs tight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower under control.
Hold the handles and lean forward with arms straight.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Bend your elbows and lower your forehead between the hands.
Keep elbows pointing forward.
Press back up to straight arms.
Move your feet back for more challenge.
Hold the handles and hinge forward with elbows by your sides.
Keep your upper arms still.
Straighten your arms and push them behind you.
Squeeze the triceps at the end.
Bend the elbows slowly to return.
Keep your back flat.
Place your feet in the straps and set a high plank.
Brace your core.
Twist your hips to one side, bringing the knees across.
Return to the center with control.
Twist to the other side.
Keep your shoulders square.
Put your feet in the straps and set a high plank.
Pull your knees up and rotate them toward one elbow.
Pause and squeeze the obliques.
Extend your legs back to plank.
Repeat to the other side.
Keep your hands firmly planted.

exercises.exerciseName: lever belt single leg romanian deadlift

instructions.originalText: Fasten the belt and stand on one leg on the platform with a slight knee bend.
Hinge at the hips and push them back as your torso lowers.
Let the free leg extend behind you for balance.
Lower until you feel a hamstring stretch, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall, then switch legs after your reps.

Sit your hips back and lower your chest.
Round the upper back gently and push the straps away.

Breathe slowly and return.

Rise onto the balls of your feet as high as you can.

Lower the heels slowly below the start if comfortable.
Use the straps only for balance.
Hold the handles and stand on one leg.

Hinge at the hip as the other leg extends behind you.

Squeeze the glute to stand back up.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
Put your feet in the straps and set a high plank.
Brace your core.
Swing your legs together to one side.
Swing back through the center to the other side.
Keep the movement slow and controlled.
Keep your shoulders stable.

exercises.exerciseName: lever lying leg curl to reverse hyperextension

instructions.originalText: Lie face down on the machine with the pads behind your lower legs.
Curl your heels toward your glutes, then lower with control.
Move into the reverse hyperextension position with the pad behind your legs.
Squeeze your glutes to raise your legs until they line up with your torso.
Lower slowly and avoid swinging.

exercises.exerciseName: smith unilateral bulgarian split squat from deficit

instructions.originalText: Set the bar on your upper back and stand with the front foot on a low plate or step.
Place the rear foot on a bench behind you.
Lower straight down until the front thigh is about parallel or deeper.
Keep your torso upright and the front knee tracking over the toes.
Push through the front heel to stand, then switch legs.

exercises.exerciseName: resistance band standing side leg raise

instructions.originalText: Loop the band around your ankles or above the knees and stand tall.
Hold onto something for balance if needed.
Lift one leg out to the side with a straight knee.
Pause at the top without leaning.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps and switch legs.
Hold the handles with arms straight and feet hip width apart.

Squeeze the glutes at the top.
Loop the band around your ankles or secure it low, and stand tall.
Hold a support for balance.
Keep your core tight.
Kick one leg straight back without arching the back.
Squeeze the glute at the end.
Return slowly, then switch legs.
Sit on the floor with legs straight and arms crossed.
Lean back slightly.
Shift your weight to one side and swing the other hip forward.
Alternate sides to walk forward.
Keep your torso upright.
Walk back to reverse.

exercises.exerciseName: lying thoracic extensions on foam roller

instructions.originalText: Lie on your back with the roller under your upper back.
Support your head with your hands.
Keep your hips on the floor and knees bent.
Gently lean back over the roller.
Return to neutral and shift the roller up or down.
Move slowly and breathe out as you extend.

Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee.

Switch sides.
Hold the handles and stand tall.
Step out wide to one side.
Bend that knee and push the hips back.
Keep your chest up and the other leg straight.
Push off to return.
Alternate sides.

Kick your feet back into a push-up position.
Perform a push-up, keeping your body in a straight line.
Jump your feet back into the squat position.
Jump up explosively, reaching your arms overhead.
Land softly and immediately lower back into a squat position to begin the next repetition.
Sit on the machine, strap in your feet and grab the handle with straight arms.
Push through your legs first, then lean back slightly.
Pull the handle to your lower ribs with elbows close.
Reverse the order: arms out, hips hinge, then knees bend to slide forward.
Keep a smooth rhythm for 10-30 minutes at a comfortable pace.
Unrack the bar at shoulder height, hands just outside your shoulders.
Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bar straight up, moving your head slightly back then through.
Lock out overhead with the bar over your mid-foot.
Lower the bar back to your collarbone with control.
Lie on your back with legs straight and hands under your hips.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Lift your legs together until they point at the ceiling.
Lower them slowly, stopping just above the floor.
Keep your back from arching throughout.
Set the bar on your shoulders and stand with the balls of your feet on a step.
Keep your knees almost straight and your torso upright.
Lower your heels for a full stretch.
Rise onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause at the top, then lower under control.

exercises.exerciseName: resistance band side lying hip abduction

instructions.originalText: Lie on your side with the band around your thighs or ankles.
Keep your legs straight and stacked.
Lift the top leg up without rolling backward.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Finish reps, then switch sides.
Sit or lie with one leg straight in front.

Relax fully.

Squeeze both glute muscles together.
Keep your legs and back still.
Hold the squeeze for 5-10 seconds.
Release fully.
Repeat for several reps.
Stand on one leg with a soft knee and your arms relaxed at your sides.

Land softly on the ball of the same foot and rebound right away.
Keep your hops small and quick, with your hips level and your core tight.
Hop for the planned time or reps, then switch legs.
Lie face down with arms bent and elbows out to the sides.
Rest your forehead lightly on the floor.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and lift your arms and chest slightly.
Form a W shape with your arms and hold for a second.
Lower slowly and repeat.
Stand facing a wall with hands on it and one foot back.
Bend both knees, keeping the back heel flat on the floor.
Lean forward until you feel a stretch low in the back calf.
Keep your hips square and chest up.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.
Lift the barbell from the floor to your collarbone using a safe clean or deadlift and curl.
Set your feet hip-width apart with hands just outside your shoulders.
Brace your core and glutes.
Press the bar straight overhead to full lockout.
Lower to your collarbone under control and repeat.

exercises.exerciseName: seated single leg calf raise on a chair

instructions.originalText: Sit on a chair with one foot flat on the floor, knee bent to 90 degrees.
Lift the other foot off the floor or tuck it behind.
Press through the ball of the working foot and raise your heel.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.
Sit tall on a chair or bench with one leg extended and the thigh muscle relaxed.

Gently glide the kneecap side to side and up and down in small, slow motions.
Keep the quad relaxed and stay in a comfortable range with no sharp pain.

Slowly straighten one knee while you lower your chin toward your chest.
Bend the knee back down while you lift your head and look up.
Keep the motion smooth and gentle, never forcing into a strong stretch or tingling.

Hold for 3-5 seconds without leaning back or tucking your hips excessively.
Relax fully, then repeat for 10-15 reps.
Sit tall on the floor or a bench with the soles of your feet together or one leg crossed in.
Let one knee drop slowly out to the side toward the floor.
Keep your back straight and your chest lifted as the knee lowers.
Pause briefly at the end of the comfortable range, then lift the knee back up.
Repeat for 8-12 reps per side.
Stand in waist-to-chest-deep water with your feet hip width apart.
Lift one knee up in front of you, then lower it and lift the other.

Continue for 2-5 minutes at an easy to moderate effort.
Hold a weight plate overhead with straight arms.

Feel the stretch in your chest muscles.

Look forward and feel the stretch along your belly.

Keep your back straight and chest lifted.

Hold for 20-30 seconds and breathe slowly.

exercises.exerciseName: 45 degree one leg hyperextension (arms in front of chest)

instructions.originalText: Set the pad under your hips and hook one foot under the roller, with the other leg lifted off.
Cross your arms over your chest and keep your body in a straight line.
Lower your torso toward the floor with a flat back.

Cross your arms over your chest and lower your torso with a flat back.

Hang from two ropes with arms straight and legs together.

exercises.exerciseName: weighted stone standing power overhead press

instructions.originalText: Lift the stone to your chest, hugging it close.
Stand with feet hip-width apart and brace your core.

Press the stone overhead to full lockout.
Lower it back to your chest with control.

Lower your chest toward the floor with control.
Explode upward so your hands leave the ground.

exercises.exerciseName: lever incline chest supported reverse delt fly (plate loaded)

instructions.originalText: Sit with your chest against the incline pad and grab the handles.
Start with arms forward and slightly bent.
Sweep your arms out and back in a wide arc.

Return slowly without letting the weight crash.
Get into a plank with hands under your shoulders and load placed on your upper back.

Lower your chest toward the floor.

Use the assistance as needed to keep every rep clean.

exercises.exerciseName: barbell incline wide reverse grip bench press

instructions.originalText: Lie on an incline bench and grip the bar wide with palms facing you.

Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Step forward with one foot and lean your chest slightly forward with a flat back.

Push through the front heel to return to standing.
Alternate legs or finish all reps on one side before switching.
Lie face down or back on an incline bench holding dumbbells.

Raise the weights forward to shoulder height with straight arms.

Lower slowly under control.
Set an incline bench under the bar and lie chest down on it.

Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Set a bench to incline and place a low pulley behind you.
Sit back with your arms hanging and grab the handles.
Curl the handles toward your shoulders, keeping elbows back.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.

exercises.exerciseName: cable standing single arm supinated grip chest press

instructions.originalText: Set a cable at chest height and hold the handle with a palm-up grip.
Stand facing away in a staggered stance.
Press the handle forward until your arm is straight.
Keep your torso still and resist twisting.
Return slowly and switch arms after your reps.
Lie on a bench holding dumbbells with palms facing each other.
Start with the weights above your chest.
Lower them to the sides of your chest, elbows slightly tucked.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your feet planted and shoulder blades pinched.

exercises.exerciseName: dumbbell standing single leg calf raise

instructions.originalText: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and stand on one foot on a step.
Hold a wall or rail with your other hand for balance.
Lower your heel to a full stretch.
Press up onto your toes as high as possible.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.
Stand facing a step box with your feet hip width apart.
Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms back.
Jump explosively up onto the box, landing softly with bent knees.
Stand tall on top, then step back down one foot at a time.
Reset and repeat, staying quick but controlled.
Stand on both feet with your knees slightly bent and your arms ready.
Push off and jump sideways, covering a comfortable distance.
Land softly on both feet with your knees tracking over your toes.
Immediately jump back to the starting side.
Keep your chest up and repeat for the planned reps or time.
Hold your hands out in front of you.
Close both hands into tight fists.
Open them fast, spreading your fingers as wide as possible.
Repeat quickly for 20-30 reps.
Keep your wrists relaxed.
Hang from a bar with arms straight and knees slightly bent.
Lower into a deep squat position.
Explode upward through your legs.
Absorb the movement softly and return to the start.
Keep your core tight and repeat.
Stand or sit tall with one elbow bent to 90 degrees at your side.
Rotate your forearm across your belly.
Move slowly through a comfortable range.
Return to the start and repeat 8-12 times.
Switch arms.
Sit tall with one arm down at your side, palm facing back.
Lower your shoulder slightly and rotate your arm inward.
Bend your wrist gently and tilt your head away.
Move slowly and stop at a mild pull, never pain.
Repeat 8-10 times, then switch arms.
Sit tall and lift one arm out to the side, palm up.
Extend your wrist and fingers backward.
Tilt your head slightly away from that arm.
Return slowly and repeat 8-10 times.
Stay within a mild stretch, then switch arms.
Sit tall with one arm out to the side.
Bend your elbow and bring your hand toward your face like a mask.
Tilt your head slightly away.
Straighten the arm back out, keeping it gentle.
Repeat 8-10 times, then switch arms.

exercises.exerciseName: barbell staggered stance stiff legged deadlift

instructions.originalText: Hold a barbell in front of your thighs and place one foot slightly behind the other, mostly on the ball of the back foot.
Keep most of your weight on the front leg with a soft knee.
Hinge at the hips, sliding the bar down your legs with a flat back.
Lower until you feel a strong hamstring stretch, then drive your hips forward to stand.
Finish all reps, then switch the stance.
Lie on your back with hands under your hips.
Lift both legs a few inches off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down in small, quick alternating moves.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Continue for 20-40 seconds.
Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend and your hands on your hips.
Tap the free foot out in front of you, then lightly out to the side.
Tap it behind you, keeping your torso upright.
Return to center and repeat the sequence under control.
Complete all reps, then switch legs.

exercises.exerciseName: single arm fingers press with ball

instructions.originalText: Hold a small ball in one palm.
Press down on it with your fingers.
Spread and squeeze with control, keeping your wrist neutral.
Hold the press for 2-3 seconds.
Repeat for reps, then switch hands.
Kneel upright with your elbows bent at about 90 degrees.
Hold your hands in front of you with palms up.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Squeeze your biceps and hold the position.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then rest.
Stand tall with your elbow bent at your side.
Press your forearm outward away from your body.
Hold for a moment at the end of your comfortable range.
Return slowly and repeat 8-12 times.
Switch arms.

exercises.exerciseName: single arm fingers press with ball v. 2

instructions.originalText: Place a ball under one hand on a table or hold it in your palm.
Spread your fingers over the ball.
Press down and hold for 2-3 seconds.
Release with control.
Repeat for reps, then switch hands.
Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Press one arm backward, keeping the elbow straight.
Move through a comfortable range.
Return slowly and repeat 8-12 times.
Switch arms.
Stand tall with your elbow bent to 90 degrees at your side.
Rotate your forearm outward away from your belly.
Keep your elbow tucked in.
Return slowly and repeat 8-12 times.
Switch arms.
Stand tall with your elbows bent in front of you.
Press your arm forward until it is straight.
Keep your shoulder relaxed.
Return slowly and repeat 8-12 times.
Switch arms.

exercises.exerciseName: bent over back to side to front arms raise

instructions.originalText: Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back and let your arms hang down.
Sweep both arms back behind your hips.
Swing them out wide to the sides up to shoulder height.
Continue the arc forward until your arms point ahead of you, then reverse the path.
Keep your neck neutral and move smoothly for the planned reps.

exercises.exerciseName: dumbbell bent over back to side to front arms raise

instructions.originalText: Hold light dumbbells and hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Start with your arms back by your hips.
Sweep the dumbbells out to the sides up to shoulder height.
Continue forward in an arc, then reverse the path with control.
Use light weights and avoid swinging your torso.

exercises.exerciseName: lying simultaneous alternating straight leg raise

instructions.originalText: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands under your hips or at your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor and brace your abs.
Raise one leg while the other lowers toward the floor, keeping both straight.
Switch legs in a smooth scissor pattern without letting your back arch.
Continue for the planned reps or time.

exercises.exerciseName: dumbbell lying single straight arm press on floor

instructions.originalText: Lie on your back on the floor with knees bent and one dumbbell held above your chest.
Keep the other arm resting on the floor beside you.
Press the dumbbell up until your arm is straight and the shoulder reaches forward.
Lower it back with control until your upper arm touches the floor.
Complete the reps, then switch arms.
Lie on your side or stomach with your legs extended.
Bend one knee and bring your heel toward your glute, holding the ankle if needed.
Move the knee in and out of the bend in a slow, controlled rhythm.
Keep your hips level and stay within a comfortable range.
Repeat for 10-15 reps, then switch legs.
Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands under your hips.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Raise both legs together until they point to the ceiling.
Lower them slowly, stopping just above the floor.
Keep your core braced and your back from arching.
Kneel on the floor with your hands slightly wider than shoulder width.
Keep your body in a straight line from your head to your knees.
Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight and your hips from sagging.
Set the bar at a low height and kneel on all fours facing it, with the sole of one foot under the bar.
Brace your abs and keep your back flat.
Press your foot up and back against the bar until your hip is fully extended.
Squeeze your glute at the top, then lower under control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
Set a bar at waist height and lie under it with extra weight on your torso.
Grip the bar just wider than shoulders.
Keep your body straight from heels to head.
Pull your chest to the bar.
Lower under control.

exercises.exerciseName: alternate straight leg raise (on bosu ball)

instructions.originalText: Lie back on a bosu ball with your lower back supported and your hands holding it lightly.
Brace your abs and extend both legs.
Raise one leg while keeping it straight.
Lower it and switch to the other leg.
Keep your torso steady and move with control.

exercises.exerciseName: dumbbell single arm curl with isometric hold

instructions.originalText: Stand holding a dumbbell at your side, palm forward.
Curl the weight up until your elbow is bent to 90 degrees.
Hold that position for 2-3 seconds.
Finish the curl, then lower slowly.
Complete your reps and switch arms.
Lie on your back with knees bent and hold a kettlebell at your chest.
Brace your core.
Curl up until your torso is upright.
Keep the kettlebell close to you.
Lower slowly back down.
Hang from a bar with straight arms.
Lift your legs straight in front until they are parallel to the floor.
Keep your toes pointed and your knees locked.
Avoid swinging.
Hold for 10-20 seconds, then lower.
Hang on a stall bar with arms straight.
Brace your core and keep your body still.
Raise your legs up in front of you.
Lift as high as you can without swinging.
Lower slowly and repeat.
Set the bar across your upper back and stand in front of a bench.
Place one foot on the bench.
Drive through that heel to stand up fully.
Step back down under control.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.
Lie back on a bench with your knees bent and a weight held on your chest.
Brace your abs and curl your upper body up.
Rotate your torso so one elbow moves toward the opposite knee.
Lower back down slowly without letting go of tension.
Alternate sides each rep.

exercises.exerciseName: lever t bar close grip row (plate loaded)

instructions.originalText: Stand on the platform with your chest supported.
Grab the close-grip handle with straight arms.
Pull the handle toward your torso, elbows close.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly to full extension.
Sit on a bosu ball and lean back slightly, holding a weight in front of you.
Lift your feet off the floor with your legs bent or straight.
Bring your chest and knees toward each other in a V shape.
Lower back with control, keeping your spine long.
Stay stable on the ball throughout.
Lie on an incline bench with your feet secured.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Curl up while rotating your torso to one side.
Lower slowly.
Alternate sides each rep.
Stand tall and hold a wall or support for balance.
Bend one knee and bring your heel toward your glute, holding the ankle.
Tuck your pelvis slightly and push your hips gently forward.
Keep your knees close together and your chest upright.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

exercises.exerciseName: standing half kneeling hip flexors stretch

instructions.originalText: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward and a pad under your knee.
Keep your torso upright and tuck your pelvis under.
Shift your weight forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the back hip.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your core engaged.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
Lie on a bench with your head just past the end, holding a weight overhead.
Keep your upper arms still and pointing up.
Bend your elbows to lower the weight toward your head.
Extend your arms to straight.
Keep your elbows tucked in.
Start in a plank position with hands under your shoulders.
Spread your arms and legs wide in an X shape.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-40 seconds.
Lie chest-down on the pad and grab the handles.
Start with your arms straight.
Pull the handles toward your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower under control.
Adjust the seat so the handles sit at upper chest height.
Sit back with your shoulder blades pinned to the pad and grip the neutral handles.
Press the handles up and forward until your arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly until you feel a stretch across the chest.
Keep your wrists straight and your back against the pad.
Lie on your side with your hips stacked and your bottom leg bent in front.
Bend the top knee and bring that foot back toward your glutes, holding it with your hand.
Gently roll your top knee back and open your chest toward the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.
Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keeping your elbow by your side, curl one dumbbell up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top, then lower it under control.
Repeat with the other arm and keep alternating.
Avoid swinging your torso to lift the weight.
Stand with your feet about shoulder width apart and toes slightly out.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower down.
Go as deep as you can while keeping your heels down and chest up.
Drive through your feet to stand back up.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Stand under a pull-up bar and grip it slightly wider than your shoulders.
Bend your knees and jump up, pulling your chin above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.
Reset on the floor and repeat.
Stand with a wide stance and grip the barbell between your legs with hands close together.
Keep your back flat and drive through your legs to stand up.
As the bar passes your hips, pull it up to chest height with your elbows high.
Lower the bar back along the same path.
Keep the bar close to your body throughout.
Hold the barbell at your upper chest with your elbows slightly in front of the bar.
Dip a few inches by bending your knees, keeping your torso upright.
Drive up through your legs and press the bar overhead.
Lock out with the bar over your mid foot, then lower it back to your chest.
Brace your core and avoid leaning back.
Start in a standing position with your feet shoulder-width apart and a dumbbell in each hand.
Lower your body into a squat position, placing the dumbbells on the ground in front of you.
Kick your feet back into a push-up position, keeping your body in a straight line.
Perform a push-up, bending your elbows and lowering your chest towards the ground.
Jump your feet back towards your hands, landing in a squat position.
Stand up explosively, lifting the dumbbells off the ground and bringing them to your shoulders.
Press the dumbbells overhead, fully extending your arms.
Lower the dumbbells back to your shoulders and repeat the entire sequence for the desired number of repetitions.
Stand with your feet hip width apart holding a kettlebell by the handle.
Pass it around your waist from one hand to the other behind your back.
Continue the circle to the front, keeping the movement smooth.
Keep your core tight and your hips still.
After several reps, reverse the direction.
Set a cable at chest height and stand sideways to the stack.
Hold the handle at your chest with both hands and brace your core.
Press the handle straight out until your arms are extended.
Hold for a second without letting your torso twist.
Bring it back to your chest and finish the set, then switch sides.

exercises.exerciseName: cable one arm inner biceps curl

instructions.originalText: Attach a handle to a low cable and stand facing the stack.
Hold the handle with one hand, palm up, and turn your elbow slightly out.
Curl the handle toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top, then lower under control.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
Attach a handle to a high pulley and sit facing the stack.
Grab the handle with one hand and sit tall.
Pull the handle down to the side of your chest, driving your elbow toward your hip.
Pause, then let your arm rise slowly.
Complete your reps and switch sides.

exercises.exerciseName: cable one arm twisting seated row

instructions.originalText: Sit at a low cable with your feet braced and grab the handle with one hand.
Start with your torso turned slightly toward the cable.
Row the handle to your side while rotating your torso open.
Squeeze your shoulder blade back, then return slowly.
Do all reps, then change arms.
Attach a rope to a low pulley and face away from the stack, holding the rope between your legs.
Step forward until the cable is taut and bend your knees slightly.
Push your hips back, letting the rope travel behind you.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes to stand tall.
Keep your back flat throughout.
Set the cable pulley low and stand sideways to the machine, holding the handle with both hands.
Start with the handle near your lower hip, arms mostly straight.
Rotate your torso and pull the handle diagonally up across your body.
Pivot your back foot and keep your hips stable.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.
Set the cable pulley high and stand sideways to the machine, holding the handle with both hands.
Start with the handle above your shoulder, arms mostly straight.
Rotate your torso and pull the handle diagonally down across your body.
Keep your hips steady and your core braced.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.
Set a cable low and stand sideways, holding the handle at your shoulder.
Brace your core and turn slightly toward the cable.
Press the handle overhead while rotating your torso to face forward.
Lower the handle back to your shoulder with control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
Set a cable at about head height and stand facing it with the handle in one hand.
Take a split stance and lean back slightly.
Pull the handle toward your upper chest, turning your torso as you go.
Squeeze your shoulder blade, then return slowly.
Complete the set and switch sides.

exercises.exerciseName: cable twisting standing one arm chest press

instructions.originalText: Set the cable at chest height and stand sideways with the handle in your inside hand.
Take a stable stance and hold the handle at your chest.
Press the handle forward while rotating your torso toward the press.
Return to the start with control.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.
Set a cable at mid height and stand facing it, holding the handle with one hand.
Stand in a stable stance with a slight lean back.
Pull the handle to your ribs and rotate your torso open.
Squeeze your shoulder blade at the end.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.
Set a cable at a high or low position and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle at your chest with both hands.
Press the handle straight up (or down) along a vertical line.
Hold for a second without letting your torso twist.
Return to your chest, finish the set, then switch sides.

exercises.exerciseName: dumbbell incline reverse grip 30 degrees bench press

instructions.originalText: Set a bench to about 30 degrees and lie back with dumbbells held palms facing you.
Start with the dumbbells at your chest.
Press them up until your arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly back to your chest.
Keep your elbows close to your body.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand or one at your chest and stand tall.
Step out wide to one side and sit your hips back.
Keep the other leg straight and your chest upright.
Push through the bent leg to return to the middle.
Alternate sides or finish all reps on one side before switching.

exercises.exerciseName: lever seated one leg calf raise

instructions.originalText: Sit on the machine and place the ball of one foot on the platform.
Set the pad on your thigh and release the safety.
Lower your heel for a stretch.
Press up as high as you can onto your toes.
