Place one hand under the wrist of your other hand to give resistance.
Curl the working hand toward your shoulder while the other hand pushes down.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch arms.
Lie on your side next to a low cable pulley and grab the handle with your top hand.
Keep your arm straight with a slight bend in the elbow.
Raise your arm out to the side until it is near shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch sides.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand facing a box or bench.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Drive through that heel to stand up tall.
Lower back down under control without bouncing off the floor foot.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.
Cross the band into an X and place it around your feet or lower legs, holding the ends as needed.
Stand in a quarter squat with your chest up.
Step sideways, keeping tension on the band.
Bring the trailing foot in without letting your feet touch.
Walk the set distance, then return the other way.

exercises.exerciseName: kettlebell kneeling one arm bottoms up press

instructions.originalText: Kneel on both knees and hold a kettlebell bottoms up at shoulder height.
Squeeze the handle tight and keep your wrist straight.
Press the bell straight overhead.
Lower slowly to your shoulder, keeping the bell balanced.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.
Hold a barbell locked out overhead with a wide grip.
Keep your arms straight and your ribs down.
Shrug your shoulders up toward your ears.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly without bending your elbows.
Kneel in front of the anchored ropes and hold an end in each hand.
Brace your abs and keep your chest up.
Raise and lower your arms alternately to create waves.
Keep the waves quick and steady.
Work for a set time, then rest.
Hold a band in front of you at chest height with palms up and elbows bent at 90 degrees.
Keep your elbows tucked near your sides.
Rotate your forearms outward, pulling the band apart.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together briefly.
Return slowly and repeat.
Stand with your back, head and hips against a wall.
Keep your arms at your sides with elbows straight.
Raise your arms forward and up overhead as far as you can without arching your back.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.exerciseName: kettlebell kneeling one arm shoulder press

instructions.originalText: Kneel on both knees with a kettlebell racked at your shoulder.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Press the kettlebell overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower it slowly back to your shoulder.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.
Stand holding the ends of the battle ropes, feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back into a lunge while making a wave with the ropes.
Push through your front heel to return to standing.
Alternate legs, keeping the rope waves going.
Work for a set time, then rest.
Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward and a kettlebell racked at your shoulder.
Brace your abs and squeeze the glute of the kneeling leg.
Press the bell straight overhead.
Lower it back under control.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

exercises.exerciseName: half kneeling pvc pec mobilization stretch

instructions.originalText: Kneel on one knee and grip a pipe or stick with one hand while the other arm reaches out.
Place the working forearm against a wall or post.
Gently rotate your torso away until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.
Kneel on one knee with the front foot flat on the floor.
Keep your front heel down.
Rock your front knee forward over your toes until you feel a stretch.
Rock back and forth slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.
Kneel in front of a stability ball with forearms on top.
Round your back slightly and tuck your pelvis.
Roll the ball forward by extending your arms.
Pull it back using your abs.
Keep your hips from sagging and move slowly.

exercises.exerciseName: band upper body resistance dead bug

instructions.originalText: Lie on your back holding a band overhead and bring your knees up at 90 degrees.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lower the opposite arm and leg while keeping band tension.
Return to the start and switch sides.
Keep your ribs down and move slowly.
Hold a kettlebell by the horns at chest height.
Stand tall with your abs braced.
Circle the bell around your head, keeping it close.
Keep your hips and ribs still.
Finish the reps, then reverse direction.
Lie face down with one arm hanging or reaching overhead, thumb up.
Keep your forehead down and neck relaxed.
Lift your arm in a Y shape by squeezing your shoulder blade down and back.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch arms.
Stand facing a wall with your forearms on it, elbows at shoulder height.
Lean in slightly and keep your abs braced.
Slide your forearms up the wall as you reach upward.
Pause at the top without arching your back.
Slide back down and repeat.
Hold a kettlebell at your shoulder and stand tall.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bell up and slightly out to the side in a diagonal path.
Lock out your arm without leaning back.
Lower under control, finish the reps, then switch arms.
Place a band around your thighs and start in a push-up position.
Brace your core.
Bring one knee toward the same-side elbow while crawling forward.
Alternate sides while keeping the band under tension.
Crawl the set distance, then rest.
Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders and legs straight.
Push your upper body up with your arms like a seal.
Keep your hips on the floor and your core tight.
Lower slowly to the floor.
Repeat for smooth, controlled reps.
Stand with your back flat against a wall and your elbows bent at your sides.
Press your forearms and head lightly into the wall.
Slide your arms up the wall while keeping your shoulder blades down.
Stop before your back arches.
Slide down slowly and repeat.
Start in a plank with one hand on the floor, the other behind your back or on your hip.
Keep your elbow locked straight.
Let your chest sink slightly between your shoulder blades.
Push the floor away to round your upper back slightly.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.
Kneel on the floor and place the roller under the front of your shin.
Support yourself with your hands on the floor.
Roll slowly up and down the shin muscle.
Pause on tight spots for a few seconds.
Switch legs and keep the pressure comfortable.
Lie face down and place the roller under one side of your chest.
Extend that arm out to the side.
Roll slowly side to side and up and down.
Pause on tight spots for a few seconds.
Switch sides and keep the pressure comfortable.
Lie on your side with the roller under your armpit area and your arm extended.
Support yourself with your lower arm and legs.
Roll slowly along your side toward the ribs.
Pause on tight spots for a few seconds.
Switch sides and keep the pressure comfortable.
Step into the belt and stand on the platforms with the belt snug on your hips.
Stand tall and brace your abs.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel.
Push through your heels to stand back up.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Sit on the machine with your back flat against the pad and feet on the platform.
Set your feet about shoulder-width apart.
Press the platform away until your legs are nearly straight.
Do not lock your knees.
Lower slowly until your knees are bent about 90 degrees and repeat.
Get on all fours and place the sole of one foot on the Smith bar, with your partner steadying you if needed.
Brace your core.
Press the bar up by extending your hip.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.exerciseName: cable standing reverse grip curl (straight bar)

instructions.originalText: Stand facing a low cable with a straight bar in an overhand grip.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders without swinging.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.exerciseName: dumbbell goblet split squat front foot elevated

instructions.originalText: Hold one dumbbell at your chest and place your front foot on a low platform.
Place your back foot behind you on the floor.
Lower your back knee toward the floor with your torso upright.
Push through your front heel to stand.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.exerciseName: dumbbell split squat front foot elevated

instructions.originalText: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and place your front foot on a low platform.
Step your back foot behind you.
Lower your back knee toward the floor with your torso upright.
Push through your front heel to stand.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand and take a long stance, one foot forward.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Push through your front heel to stand.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.
Start in a plank with a dumbbell in each hand and your feet wide.
Do a push-up, keeping your body straight.
Row one dumbbell up to your ribs without twisting your hips.
Lower it and row the other side.
Repeat the sequence with control.

exercises.exerciseName: lever seated hammer grip shoulder press

instructions.originalText: Sit with your back against the pad and grip the neutral handles.
Keep your feet flat on the floor.
Press the handles overhead until your arms are almost straight.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly to shoulder height and repeat.
Sit on the captain's chair with your back against the backrest and your forearms resting on the arm pads.
Keep your upper body stable and your back straight.
Engage your abs and lift your legs up in front of you, keeping them straight.
Continue lifting until your legs are parallel to the ground or as high as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Sit on the floor with a barbell over your hips, padded if needed.
Roll back, set your feet, and hold the bar with both hands.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your shoulders, elbows forward.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Hold dumbbells at your shoulders and stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up through your heels and press the dumbbells overhead in one motion.
Lock out your arms at the top.
Lower the weights to your shoulders and go straight into the next rep.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your shoulders.
Squat down with your chest tall and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up through your heels as you stand.
Use that momentum to press the dumbbells overhead.
Lower them to your shoulders and go into the next squat.
Stand on the band and hold the ends at your shoulders.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up and press your hands overhead in one motion.
Lock out your arms at the top.
Lower your hands to your shoulders and repeat.
Stand tall with your feet together and hands in front of your chest.
Step wide to one side.
Bend that knee and sit your hips back, keeping the other leg straight.
Push off the bent leg to return.
Alternate sides.

exercises.exerciseName: lever one arm chest press (plate loaded)

instructions.originalText: Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and grip one handle.
Set your feet flat on the floor.
Press the handle forward until your arm is nearly straight.
Pause briefly.
Return slowly, finish the reps, then switch arms.
Hold the end of the landmine bar at your chest with both hands.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up and press the bar away until your arms are straight.
Lower the bar to your chest and repeat.

exercises.exerciseName: elbow up and down dynamic plank

instructions.originalText: Start in a forearm plank with your body in a straight line.
Place one hand on the floor and press up to a high plank.
Place the other hand down.
Lower back to your forearms one arm at a time.
Alternate the leading arm and keep your hips still.
Start in a high plank with a dumbbell in each hand and your feet wide.
Brace your core.
Row one dumbbell to your ribs without twisting your hips.
Lower it with control.
Repeat on the other side.
Lie on the floor with a dumbbell in each hand and knees bent.
Press both dumbbells up over your chest.
Lower one dumbbell until your upper arm touches the floor.
Press it back up and lower the other side.
Keep alternating.
Stand in front of a box with one leg extended forward.
Brace your core and reach your arms forward for balance.
Sit back and down slowly on the standing leg until you touch the box.
Drive through your heel to stand.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.exerciseName: weighted hammer grip pull up on dip cage

instructions.originalText: Attach a belt or vest with weight and grip the neutral handles of the cage.
Hang with your arms straight and your core braced.
Pull your chest up until your chin passes the handles.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly to a full hang and repeat.

exercises.exerciseName: weighted close grip chin-up on dip cage

instructions.originalText: Stand in front of the dip cage and grab the parallel bars with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Hang from the bars with your arms fully extended, feet off the ground, and body straight.
Engage your back muscles and pull your body up towards the bars, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bars, then pause for a moment.
Slowly lower your body back down to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder width.
Sink into a deep squat, keeping your heels down.
Press your elbows gently against your knees.
Rock side to side and sit tall.
Spend 30-45 seconds there, then stand up.
Stand with your feet a little wider than shoulder width and toes turned out slightly.
Sink into a deep squat and keep your heels on the floor.
Press your elbows against your knees to open the hips and hold for a moment.
Shift gently from side to side, then rock forward and back.
Stand up tall and repeat the flow for 6-8 rounds.
Keep your chest lifted and your back long throughout.
Rest a light barbell across your upper back and hold it with both hands.
Stand tall with your core braced and rise onto the balls of your feet.
Walk forward in small, controlled steps without letting your heels drop.
Keep your ankles steady and your hips level.
Walk 10-15 metres, rest, then repeat for a few rounds.
Use a light load so you can stay high on your toes.

exercises.exerciseName: rollball seated single leg shoulder flexor depressor retractor

instructions.originalText: Sit tall on a stability ball with your feet on the floor.
Lift one foot slightly off the ground and hold your balance.
Raise your arms forward, then press your shoulders down away from your ears.
Pull your shoulder blades back and together without arching your back.
Return slowly to the start and complete your reps.
Switch legs and repeat on the other side.
Sit on the floor with one calf resting on a barbell.
Support yourself with your hands behind you.
Roll your calf slowly back and forth over the bar.
Pause on tender spots for a few breaths.
Switch to the other leg.
Hold a kettlebell by the horns against your chest.
Stand with your feet wider than your shoulders and toes slightly out.
Squat down as deep as you comfortably can with your chest up.
Use your elbows to push your knees out and pause at the bottom.
Rock gently side to side to open the hips.
Drive through your feet to stand back up.
Kneel on a mat with the foam roller under your shins.
Support yourself with your hands in front.
Shift your weight to roll along the front of your lower leg.
Move slowly and pause on tight spots.
Roll for 30-60 seconds per leg.
Stand on the band with your feet hip width apart and hold the other end at shoulder height.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.
Press the hand straight overhead until your arm is almost straight.
Lower under control back to your shoulder.
Complete your reps without leaning sideways.
Switch arms and repeat.
Loop a band over the pull-up bar and place a foot or knee in it.
Grab the bar with an overhand grip a little wider than your shoulders.
Hang with your arms long and your shoulders engaged.
Pull your chest toward the bar by driving your elbows down.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight again.
Use a thinner band as you get stronger.
Sit on a chair or the floor with one leg extended.
Point your toes away from you so the top of the foot lengthens.
Slowly circle or press the foot until you feel a comfortable stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without forcing it.
Release and switch legs.
Repeat 2-3 times on each side.

exercises.exerciseName: resistance band standing back achilles stretch

instructions.originalText: Loop a resistance band around the front of the foot of your back leg.
Hold the band ends in your hands and stand tall.
Step that leg back with the heel on the floor.
Pull the band gently so your toes move toward your shin.
Hold for 20-30 seconds with your back leg fairly straight.
Switch sides and repeat.

exercises.exerciseName: resistance band standing forward achilles stretch

instructions.originalText: Loop a resistance band around the ball of your front foot.
Hold the band ends and stand tall.
Place the front heel on the floor with the toes lifted.
Pull the band so your toes draw toward you and lean slightly forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds with a comfortable stretch.
Switch feet and repeat.
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and toes slightly out.
Brace your core and lift your chest.
Bend at the hips and knees to lower into a squat.
Push your knees out so they follow the line of your toes.
Go down as deep as feels controlled.
Drive up through your whole foot to stand.
Kneel and place one hand under your shoulder, with the other arm behind your back.
Spread your knees a bit wider for balance.
Keep a straight line from your head to your knees.
Lower your chest toward the floor with control.
Press back up without twisting your hips.
Switch arms and repeat.
Stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Start walking at a pace faster than a stroll.
Swing your arms naturally with elbows bent.
Land on your heel and roll through to your toes.
Keep breathing steadily and stay able to talk.
Walk for 20-45 minutes.
Sit on a chair or bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Wrap the resistance band around your thighs, just above your knees.
Place your hands on the sides of the chair or bench for support.
Engage your abductors (outer thigh muscles) and slowly push your knees apart, against the resistance of the band.
Pause for a moment at the end of the movement, then slowly bring your knees back together.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Attach the resistance band to a sturdy anchor point and secure it around your ankle.
Stand facing the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Keeping your core engaged and your upper body stable, extend your leg straight out in front of you.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly return your leg to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
Stand at the bottom of a staircase, standing tall.
Step up with one foot, placing your whole foot on the step.
Press through your heel and bring the other foot up.
Keep your torso upright and swing your arms naturally.
Continue at a steady pace and alternate the leading leg.

exercises.exerciseName: ez bar lying bent arms pullover

instructions.originalText: Lie flat on a bench with your head at one end and your feet on the floor.
Hold the EZ barbell with a pronated grip (palms facing away from you) and your hands shoulder-width apart.
Extend your arms straight above your chest, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower the barbell in an arc motion behind your head, maintaining the slight bend in your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then return the barbell to the starting position by reversing the arc motion.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Place your hands on a flat bench or another raised surface, shoulder-width apart, and walk your feet back into a straight-body plank.
Keep your elbows locked straight for the whole set.
Let your chest sink toward the bench as your shoulder blades squeeze together.
Push the bench away to spread your shoulder blades apart.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Sit on a bench with your hands flat on it beside your hips and your arms straight.
Keep your elbows locked straight for the whole set.
Press your shoulders down, away from your ears, so your hips lift slightly off the bench.
Let your shoulders rise back toward your ears to lower your hips.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your arms by your sides, palms facing down.
Engage your glutes and core, then lift your hips off the ground until your body forms a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your glutes.
Slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your chest up.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Pull the barbell towards your upper abdomen, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Rise up onto the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Pause at the top for a second.
Lower your heels slowly back to the floor.
Hold a wall for balance if needed.
Position yourself under a bar or a sturdy horizontal surface that is at chest height.
Grab the bar or surface with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hang with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Pull your chest towards the bar or surface by squeezing your shoulder blades together and bending your elbows.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar or surface.
Lower yourself back down to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Keep your elbows locked straight for the whole set.
Let your chest sink between your shoulder blades as they squeeze together.
Push the floor away to spread your shoulder blades apart, rounding your upper back slightly.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.exerciseName: band lying hip internal rotation v. 2

instructions.originalText: Lie on your back with a band around your lower leg anchored to the side.
Bend your knees with your feet on the floor.
Rotate your lower leg outward against the band, turning the hip inward.
Return slowly to the start.
Complete your reps and switch legs.
Rest a barbell across your upper back and step one foot forward.
Stand with a long stride and your torso upright.
Bend both knees and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front heel down and your front knee over your foot.
Press through the front foot to rise.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
Start on hands and knees with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Lift one leg with the knee bent at 90 degrees.
Push the sole of your foot toward the ceiling and squeeze your glute.
Lower slowly without arching your back.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.
Start on hands and knees with a flat back.
Keep your knee bent at about 90 degrees.
Lift the bent leg out to the side to hip height.
Squeeze your outer hip at the top without rotating your torso.
Lower under control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
Stand tall with your arms bent at your sides.
Jog on the spot or move forward slowly.
Kick each heel up toward your glute.
Stay on the balls of your feet and keep your knees pointing down.
Pump your arms in rhythm.
Continue for 20-40 seconds.

exercises.exerciseName: cable bar high pulley overhead tricep extension

instructions.originalText: Attach a bar to a high pulley and face away from the machine.
Hold the bar behind your head with elbows pointing forward.
Step forward and stagger your feet.
Extend your arms to press the bar overhead.
Lower slowly back and keep your elbows in place.
Attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley and strap it to your outer ankle.
Stand sideways to the machine and hold a support.
Keep your torso upright and your standing leg slightly bent.
Lift the cuffed leg out to the side.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Finish your reps and switch legs.
Attach a rope to a low pulley and hold an end in each hand.
Stand tall with elbows by your sides.
Curl the rope up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower under control without swinging.
Lie on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand pressed together over your chest.
Keep your palms facing each other.
Lower the dumbbells to your chest with your elbows tucked.
Press back up while keeping the weights touching.
Keep your wrists straight.
Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang by your sides, palms forward.
Curl the weights up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top and keep elbows pinned.
Lower slowly to full extension.
Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arm on the pad.
Hold a dumbbell with your palm facing up.
Curl the weight toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly until nearly straight, then switch arms.
Stand tall with your hands behind your head.
Lift one knee up and across your body.
Twist your torso to meet the knee with the opposite elbow.
Return to standing.
Alternate sides at a steady pace.
Keep your chest lifted and breathe evenly.
Stand with your feet wider than your shoulders and sink into a deep squat.
Place your fingertips on the floor between your feet.
Jump forward and up, swinging your arms.
Land softly back in the squat.
Reset and hop again right away.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Stand tall and relaxed.
Skip forward, driving one knee up high.
Hop lightly on the other foot.
Swing the opposite arm forward with each knee.
Alternate legs in a smooth rhythm.
Keep your chest up and land softly.
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up through your feet to stand.
Lift one knee toward your chest as you reach the top.
Lower the foot and go back into the squat.
Alternate knees on each rep.
Stand with your feet together and your arms at your sides.
Jump your feet apart as you swing your arms overhead.
Jump back to the start position.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady rhythm.
Continue for 30-60 seconds.
Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee.
Push off hard to leap sideways.
Land on the opposite foot and bend to absorb the impact.
Hold the landing for a second to stay balanced.
Bound back the other way.
Keep your chest up and your knee over your toes.

exercises.exerciseName: lever alternating narrow grip seated row (plate loaded)

instructions.originalText: Sit with your chest against the pad and grab the narrow handles.
Pull one handle back, driving your elbow behind you.
Squeeze your shoulder blade at the end.
Return slowly and pull with the other arm.
Alternate sides and keep your torso still.

exercises.exerciseName: lever narrow grip seated row (plate loaded)

instructions.originalText: Sit with your chest against the pad and take the narrow handles.
Pull both handles toward your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Pause briefly.
Return slowly with control.
Stand with your feet together.
Jump your feet wide and land in a quarter squat.
Swing your arms out as you land.
Jump your feet back together.
Land softly each time.
Keep a quick, controlled pace.
Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee.
Leap sideways to the other leg.
Land softly and sweep the back leg behind you.
Swing your arms across your body for balance.
Immediately bound back the other way.
Keep your hips low and your chest forward.
Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and the Smith bar over your hips.
Pad the bar and roll it into the crease of your hips.
Plant your feet hip width apart and unrack the bar.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your body is level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.
Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Jump one foot forward and the other back as you swing opposite arms.
Land softly with soft knees.
Jump again and switch legs.
Keep your torso upright.
Continue at a steady pace for 30-45 seconds.
Start on hands and knees with a flat back.
Brace your core.
Extend one leg straight back.
Lift it to hip height and squeeze your glute.
Lower without letting your back arch.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
Attach the band to a sturdy anchor point above your head.
Stand facing the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the band with an underhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Step back to create tension in the band, keeping your arms fully extended.
Engage your core and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Pull the band down towards your chest, leading with your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, feeling the contraction in your lats.
Slowly release the tension in the band and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.exerciseName: band fixed back close grip pulldown

instructions.originalText: Attach the band to a fixed point above you, such as a pull-up bar or sturdy beam.
Sit down on a bench or chair facing the band, with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent.
Grasp the band with a close grip, palms facing towards you.
Keep your back straight and engage your core.
Pull the band down towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, feeling the contraction in your lats.
Slowly release the band back to the starting position, maintaining control throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outward.
Lower your body down by bending your knees and pushing your hips back as if you were sitting on a chair.
Keep your chest up and your back straight throughout the movement.
Lower yourself until your thighs are parallel to the ground or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Stand holding a wall or rail for balance.
Place your feet hip-width apart.
Rise up on your toes as high as you can.
Pause and squeeze your calves.
Lower slowly.
Sit on the floor with legs extended and a band around your feet.
Hold the ends with your arms straight.
Sit tall with a flat back.
Pull the band toward your waist, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.
Sit on a chair or bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold the resistance band with both hands, palms facing forward, and bring it up to shoulder level.
Press the band overhead, extending your arms fully.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the band back down to shoulder level.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Sit on a chair or bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold the resistance band with an underhand grip, palms facing up, and arms extended down by your sides.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the resistance band up towards your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the resistance band back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Sit on a chair or bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold the resistance band handles in each hand, with your palms facing down and elbows bent at a 90-degree angle.
Extend your arms forward, pushing the resistance band away from your chest.
Pause for a moment at the end of the movement, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Sit with one leg out and a band looped around the forefoot.
Anchor the other end to a fixed point on the inside.
Keep your heel still on the floor.
Turn your foot outward against the band.
Return slowly to the start.
Complete your reps, then switch feet.
Sit with your leg straight and a band looped around the ball of your foot.
Hold the band ends in your hands.
Point your toes away from you against the band.
Pause at the end of the range.
Return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch feet.
Sit with your leg extended and a band around your forefoot.
Anchor the band on the inside of your foot.
Keep your leg still.
Turn the sole of your foot outward against the band.
Return slowly.
Complete your reps, then switch feet.
Sit with your leg extended and a band around your forefoot.
Anchor the band on the outside of your foot.
Keep your leg still.
Turn the sole of your foot inward against the band.
Return slowly.
Complete your reps, then switch feet.
Stand or sit tall with your arms forward at shoulder height.
Pull your shoulder blades together behind you.
Hold for a moment.
Then push your hands forward and let the blades spread apart.
Move slowly between the two positions.
Keep your neck relaxed and your ribs down.
Stand or sit tall with your arms at your sides.
Shrug your shoulders up toward your ears.
Hold for a second.
Press your shoulders down away from your ears.
Move slowly through the full range.
Keep your arms relaxed and your head still.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outward.
Hold onto a stable support, such as a chair or wall, for balance.
Lower your body down into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
Keep your chest up and your back straight throughout the movement.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Start on all fours with a neutral spine.
Extend one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
Keep your hips level and avoid arching your back.
Pause for a moment.
Return and switch sides.
Set up the smith machine with the barbell at hip height.
Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, toes pointing outwards.
Position yourself under the barbell, resting it on your upper back and shoulders.
Engage your core and keep your chest up as you lower your body down into a squat position, pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Lower yourself until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.exerciseName: resistance band seated straight back row

instructions.originalText: Sit on the floor with your legs extended and loop the resistance band around your feet.
Hold the ends of the resistance band with your hands, palms facing each other.
Keep your back straight and lean slightly back, engaging your core.
Pull the resistance band towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly release the tension and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Start in a high plank position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
Once your chest is just above the ground, push through your hands to extend your arms and lift your upper body up.
At the top of the movement, protract your shoulder blades by pushing your upper back towards the ceiling.
Pause for a moment, then reverse the movement by retracting your shoulder blades and lowering your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands by your sides.
Engage your abs and tilt your pelvis upward, pressing your lower back into the ground.
Hold this position for a few seconds, focusing on contracting your abs.
Release the tilt and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Sit or stand tall with your eyes level.
Place a finger on your chin if it helps.
Draw your chin straight back as if making a double chin.
Keep your head level without tilting.
Hold for 3-5 seconds.
Release and repeat 8-10 times.
Sit or stand tall with your eyes level.
Place two fingers on your chin.
Gently guide your chin straight back.
Keep your head level and your shoulders relaxed.
Hold for 3-5 seconds.
Release and repeat 8-10 times.
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Drop your hands to the floor and jump your feet back to a plank.
Do a push-up, then jump your feet back in.
Stand up and kick one leg out to the side.
Land and go straight into the next rep.
Alternate kicking sides.

exercises.exerciseName: bodyweight standing close-grip one arm row

instructions.originalText: Stand facing a wall bar with your feet close to it.
Grip a rung at chest height with one hand.
Lean back until that arm is straight, body in a line from head to heels.
Pull your chest toward the bar, keeping your elbow close to your side.
Lower back slowly, finish the reps, then switch arms.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Bend forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Extend your arms straight in front of you, gripping the bar or handles with a close grip.
Pull the bar or handles towards your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly release and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.exerciseName: bodyweight standing one arm row (with towel)

instructions.originalText: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and hold a towel with one hand.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Pull the towel towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the towel back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
Stand facing a wall bar with your feet near its base.
Hold a rung at chest height with one hand.
Lean back until your arm is straight and your body is in a line.
Row your chest toward the bar, squeezing your shoulder blade.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch arms.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a towel in front of you with both hands.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Pull the towel towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly release the tension and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Grasp a bar or handles with an overhand grip, palms facing down.
Keep your back straight and core engaged.
Pull the bar or handles towards your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement.
Slowly release and extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a towel in front of you with your palms facing down.
Bend your knees and lower your body into a squat position, keeping your back straight and your chest up.
As you lower into the squat, simultaneously pull the towel towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the squat, then slowly return to the starting position while extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding onto a sturdy object or suspension trainer with your arms extended.
Lower your body into a squat position, keeping your back straight and your knees behind your toes.
From the squat position, pull your body up towards the object or suspension trainer, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Stand in a boxing stance with your hands up.
Bend your right elbow to about 90 degrees.
Pivot on your back foot and rotate your hips and torso.
Swing your fist in an arc to your target.
Snap back to guard position.
Keep your chin tucked and your left hand up.
Lie on a bench and lift your feet with your knees bent to 90 degrees.
Grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Unrack and hold it over your chest.
Lower the bar to your mid chest with control.
Press it back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your lower back flat on the bench.
Lie on a bench holding dumbbells above your chest.
Lift your feet so your knees are bent to 90 degrees.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Open your arms out wide until you feel a chest stretch.
Bring the dumbbells back together over your chest.
Move slowly and keep your back flat.

exercises.exerciseName: dumbbell straight arm pullover (knees at 90 degrees)

instructions.originalText: Lie on a bench with your feet up and knees at 90 degrees.
Hold one dumbbell with both hands above your chest.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Lower the dumbbell in an arc behind your head.
Pull it back over your chest.
Keep your ribs down and your back flat.

exercises.exerciseName: stability ball reverse hyperextension (off a bench)

instructions.originalText: Lie face down with your hips over the ball and hands on the floor.
Hold the bench or the ball for stability.
Lift your legs until they are in line with your body.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower with control.
Lie face down on an incline bench with hips at the edge.
Hold the sides of the bench.
Raise both legs until they are in line with your torso.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.
Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees dropped open.
Bring your heels close to your hips.
Drive your hips up by squeezing your glutes.
Pause at the top.
Lower and repeat in quick pumps.
Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees open.
Rest a weight on your hips.
Drive your hips up by squeezing your glutes.
Pause at the top.
Lower and repeat.

exercises.exerciseName: barbell hang clean below the knees v. 2

instructions.originalText: Stand with the bar hanging below your knees in an overhand grip.
Hinge back with a flat back and shoulders over the bar.
Drive your hips forward and jump explosively.
Shrug and pull your elbows high.
Drop under the bar and catch it on your shoulders.
Stand tall, then lower the bar under control.
Set up the bar with bands hanging kettlebells or weights from each end.
Rest the bar across your upper back and step out.
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down with a braced core.
Drive up through your feet.
Use a lighter load and move slowly.

exercises.exerciseName: barbell bench press (with hanging band technique)

instructions.originalText: Hang weights from each end of the bar with bands.
Lie on the bench and unrack the bar.
Hold it over your chest.
Lower the bar slowly to your mid chest.
Press up and keep the bar steady.
Use a lighter load than a normal bench press.

exercises.exerciseName: barbell military press (with hanging band technique)

instructions.originalText: Hang weights from each end of the bar with bands.
Hold the bar at your shoulders and stand tall.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bar straight overhead.
Lower it slowly back to your shoulders.
Use a lighter load and keep the bar steady.
Hold a kettlebell at your chest with both hands.
Squat down with your chest tall.
Explode upward into a jump.
Land softly with bent knees.
Reset and go into the next squat.

exercises.exerciseName: dumbbell straight arm pullover (with hanging band technique)

instructions.originalText: Hang a weight from the dumbbell with a band.
Lie on a bench and hold it above your chest with straight arms.
Lower it in an arc behind your head.
Pull it back over your chest slowly.
Keep your ribs down and your core tight.
Use a light load to stay controlled.
Adjust the glute-ham raise machine to fit your body.
Position yourself face down on the machine with your ankles secured.
Place your hands on your chest or cross them over your chest.
Engage your hamstrings and glutes to lift your upper body up towards the ceiling.
Continue lifting until your body is in a straight line from your head to your heels.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the barbell in front of your body with straight arms.
Keeping your back straight, lower your body by bending at the knees and hips, as if sitting back into a chair.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Lie face down on the leg curl machine with the pad just above your heels and your knees just past the bench.
Hold the handles and keep your hips pressed down.
Curl the pad up toward your glutes with both legs.
Take one leg off the pad and lower the weight slowly with the other.
Curl up with both legs again and lower with the other leg next time.
Stand tall with your knees slightly bent.
Run on the spot as fast as you can with small steps.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Pump your arms.
Keep your chest up.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.
Stand tall and relaxed.
Move forward in a bouncy trot.
Lift each knee up with a springy step.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Swing your arms in rhythm.
Continue for 30-60 seconds.
Stand with your knees slightly bent.
Hop forward and to one side.
Land softly on both feet.
Hop forward and to the other side.
Keep your hops light and quick.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.
Stand tall and relaxed.
Step forward and hop on the same foot.
Switch and hop on the other foot.
Swing the opposite arm forward with each step.
Stay light on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady rhythm.
Adjust the seat height and position yourself facing the machine.
Grasp the v-bar with an overhand grip, keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent.
Pull the v-bar towards your abdomen, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly release the weight back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Extend your arms overhead, keeping them straight.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is upright.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Start by kneeling on the ground with your hands shoulder-width apart, fingers pointing forward.
Extend your legs behind you, resting on the balls of your feet, so that your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
Engage your core and lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
Continue lowering until your chest is just above the ground, then push back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms by your sides.
Bend forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent.
Reach down towards your toes with your hands, keeping your legs as straight as possible.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended to the sides.
Bend at the waist to the right, reaching your right hand towards your right foot while keeping your left hand extended to the side.
Return to the starting position and then bend at the waist to the left, reaching your left hand towards your left foot while keeping your right hand extended to the side.
Repeat the side-to-side bending motion for the desired number of repetitions.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and arms extended to the sides.
Keeping your legs straight, bend forward at the waist and reach down towards your toes with your right hand.
As you reach down, simultaneously lift your left leg straight up behind you, maintaining balance.
Return to the starting position and repeat the movement with your left hand reaching towards your toes and your right leg lifting up behind you.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.exerciseName: hands reversed clasped circular toe touch (male)

instructions.originalText: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended to the sides.
Bend forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent.
Reach down with your hands and clasp them together behind your legs.
Slowly raise your hands up and over your head in a circular motion, keeping your legs straight.
Continue the circular motion until your hands touch your toes.
Reverse the motion and bring your hands back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Start in a high plank position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your body in a straight line.
Lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
As you lower yourself, tap your chest with your right hand.
Push yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat the movement, this time tapping your chest with your left hand.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
Start in a push-up position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your feet hip-width apart.
Lower your body towards the ground, bending your elbows and keeping your core engaged.
As you lower your body, shift your weight back and lift your hips up towards the ceiling, creating an inverted V shape with your body.
Continue to lower your body until your chest is just above the ground, then reverse the movement, pushing your hips back down and extending your arms to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands clasped together in front of your chest.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Lower your hands towards your toes in a circular motion, reaching as far as you can without straining.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Jump off the ground and simultaneously cross your right leg in front of your left leg.
As you land, quickly switch legs, crossing your left leg in front of your right leg.
Continue alternating legs and jumping as quickly as possible.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and lower your body into a squat position.
Jump explosively upwards, extending your legs and arms.
While in the air, spread your legs apart and bring your arms out to the sides.
Land softly with your feet shoulder-width apart, bending your knees to absorb the impact.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your arms bent in front of your chest.
Lift one knee up to about hip height while the standing knee bends slightly.
Put the foot back down and lift the other knee the same way.
Keep alternating at a steady pace, chest up and core braced.
Repeat for 30-60 seconds.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and lower your body into a squat position.
Jump explosively, extending your hips and knees while swinging your arms for momentum.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and immediately go into the next repetition.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms by your sides.
Bend your knees slightly and jump up explosively.
As you jump, spread your legs and extend your arms out to the sides, forming a star shape with your body.
Land softly on the balls of your feet with your knees slightly bent.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Stand with your feet together and your arms by your sides.
Jump up, spreading your feet apart and raising your arms above your head.
As you land, quickly jump back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Lie face down with your arms out to the sides in a T.
Keep your forehead near the floor.
Turn your thumbs up toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and lift your arms.
Pause for a second.
Lower slowly and repeat.
Lie face down with your palms under your thighs.
Keep your neck long and look at the floor.
Lift your chest off the ground using your back muscles.
Squeeze your glutes.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.
Lower slowly and rest.
Lie face down with your arms extended in front.
Lift your chest and legs slightly off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down in small, fast alternations.
Keep your neck long.
Breathe steadily.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.
Lie face down with your hands beside your head.
Keep your legs straight and your feet on the floor.
Lift your chest using your lower back.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your neck in line with your spine.
Lie face down with your hands near your shoulders.
Lift your chest off the floor.
Press your arms forward in front of you.
Pull them back to your shoulders.
Lower your chest slowly.
Keep your neck long throughout.
Lie face down with your hands clasped behind your lower back.
Keep your neck long and look at the floor.
Lift your chest off the floor.
Reach your hands toward your feet.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.
Lower slowly and rest.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended out to the sides.
Bend forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent.
Reach down towards your toes with both hands, keeping your legs straight.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.exerciseName: cable standing rear delt horizontal row (with rope)

instructions.originalText: Attach a rope to a cable at chest height.
Hold the ends and step back.
Stand with your knees slightly bent.
Pull the rope toward your face with your elbows high and wide.
Squeeze your rear shoulders.
Return slowly.
Sit at a cable row with your feet braced.
Grip the handle with your palms facing up.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull the handle toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly without rounding your back.
Lie flat on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Extend your arms straight up over your chest, with a slight bend in your elbows.
Keeping a slight bend in your elbows, lower the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Pause for a moment, then reverse the movement and bring the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Adjust the cable machine so that the ankle attachment is at the lowest setting.
Lie face down on the bench with your legs straight and the ankle attachment secured to your ankles.
Hold onto the handles of the bench for stability.
Keeping your upper body stationary, exhale and curl your legs up towards your glutes by flexing your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your hamstrings.
Inhale and slowly lower your legs back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.exerciseName: resistance band hip thrusts on knees (female)

instructions.originalText: Start by kneeling on the ground with your knees hip-width apart and your feet flexed.
Wrap the resistance band around your thighs, just above your knees.
Place your hands on your hips or extend them out in front of you for balance.
Engage your glutes and core muscles.
Push your hips forward and squeeze your glutes as you lift your knees off the ground, extending your hips until your thighs are parallel to the ground.
Hold the position for a moment, then slowly lower your knees back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Stand side-on to a landmine with your feet hip-width apart.
Hold the end of the bar in the hand nearer the anchor, arm straight by your hip.
Raise the bar out to the side and up until your arm points overhead, keeping it straight.
Lower it slowly back to your hip.
Finish the reps, then turn around and switch arms.
Kneel and place your forearms on the floor under your shoulders.
Lift your hips so your body is in a line from your knees to your head.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Keep your neck neutral.
Hold for 20-45 seconds.
Lower and rest.
Start in a kneeling position with your hands on the ground, shoulder-width apart.
Extend your legs behind you, resting on your toes, and lift your body into a plank position.
Keeping your core engaged and your hips stable, lift one hand off the ground and tap the opposite shoulder.
Return the hand to the ground and repeat with the other hand.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.exerciseName: exercise ball on the wall calf raise (tennis ball between knees)

instructions.originalText: Stand with your back against a wall and place an exercise ball between your lower back and the wall.
Position your feet shoulder-width apart and slightly in front of you.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, with your arms extended by your sides.
Place a tennis ball between your knees.
Raise your heels off the ground, lifting your body up onto your toes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.exerciseName: exercise ball on the wall calf raise (tennis ball between ankles)

instructions.originalText: Stand facing a wall with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Place an exercise ball between the wall and your lower back.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, with your arms extended by your sides.
Place a tennis ball between your ankles.
Raise your heels off the ground, lifting your body up onto your toes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Pull one knee toward your chest with both hands.
Keep your lower back relaxed on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.
Lie on your back.
Pull both knees toward your chest.
Wrap your arms around your shins.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly.
Lie face down with hands under your shoulders.
Press up, lifting your chest.
Keep your hips on the floor.
Look straight ahead and relax.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.

exercises.exerciseName: feet and ankles side to side stretch

instructions.originalText: Sit with your legs extended.
Keep your heels on the floor.
Roll your feet slowly to the outside.
Then roll them inward.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.
Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge forward and reach toward your toes.
Let your head hang relaxed.
Rise slowly.
Repeat at a steady pace.
Stand with feet wide apart.
Hinge forward with both arms reaching down.
Touch the floor or your toes.
Rise slowly.
Repeat for the set.
Stand with your feet wide apart.
Reach one hand toward the opposite foot.
Keep your other arm extended behind you.
Rise and switch sides.
Alternate at an easy pace.
Stand with feet wide apart.
Turn your torso slightly to one side.
Reach both hands to the foot on that side.
Rise, then turn to the other side.
Repeat at a steady pace.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Raise one arm overhead.
Bend sideways, reaching over to the other side.
Return to upright.
Switch sides and repeat.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Clasp your hands overhead.
Bend to one side, keeping your hips still.
Return to the center.
Bend to the other side and repeat.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Place your hands behind your head with elbows out.
Bend to one side without twisting.
Return to the center.
Bend to the other side and repeat.
Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend one arm out to the side.
Make slow circles, gradually larger.
Reverse the direction.
Switch arms.
Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend both arms out to the sides.
Make slow circles forward.
Then reverse direction.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and arms hanging at your sides.
Swing one arm forward, up and back in a large smooth circle.
As that arm finishes, start the same circle with the other arm.
Keep your ribs down and your neck relaxed.
Continue alternating for 20-30 seconds, then reverse the direction.
Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and arms out in front at chest height.
Fling both arms wide open to the sides, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Swing them back across your body, letting one arm cross over the other.
Keep the motion loose and controlled, without arching your back.
Repeat for 15-20 swings.
Lie on your back with legs straight and hands under your hips or by your sides.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Lift both legs together until they point at the ceiling.
Lower them slowly, stopping just above the floor.
Keep your legs straight and do not let your back arch.
Lie on your side and prop yourself up on one forearm with elbow under the shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Raise your top leg to about hip height, toes pointing forward.
Lower it a little without dropping your hips.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.exerciseName: kneeling push up to child pose

instructions.originalText: Start on your hands and knees with hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor, elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up to the start.
Push your hips back onto your heels and reach your arms forward into child pose.
Return to the start and repeat.
Start in a forearm plank with body in a straight line.
Press up onto one hand, then the other, into a high plank.
Lower back down to your forearms one arm at a time.
Keep your hips steady and avoid rocking side to side.
Alternate which arm leads each rep.
Lie on your back with arms out to the sides and legs raised straight up.
Keep your shoulders on the floor.
Lower both legs toward one side, stopping just above the floor.
Bring them back up through the middle.
Repeat to the other side and keep alternating.
Stand tall with feet under your hips.
Run on the spot at a steady pace, pumping your arms.
Every few steps, hop off one foot and land softly.
Stay light on the balls of your feet.
Keep going for 30-60 seconds at a pace you can hold.
Stand tall and start jogging on the spot.
After a few steps, jump your feet wide while raising your arms overhead.
Jump your feet back together and lower the arms.
Resume running and repeat the pattern.
Keep your landings soft and keep going for 30-60 seconds.
Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Jog on the spot for a few steps.
Pause into a shallow knee bend, hips back and chest up.
Stand tall and go straight back into running.
Repeat for 30-60 seconds.
Stand tall and run on the spot for a few steps.
Drop into a half squat with your chest up.
Jump up, swinging your arms.
Land softly with bent knees and go back to running.
Repeat for 30-60 seconds.
Lie on your back and rest your lower legs on a bench, knees bent at about 90 degrees.
Place your hands lightly behind your head or across your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor by squeezing your abs.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat without pulling on your neck.

exercises.exerciseName: floor twisting crunch feet on bench

instructions.originalText: Lie on your back with your calves on a bench and knees bent.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Curl up and rotate so one shoulder moves toward the opposite knee.
Lower with control.
Alternate sides on each rep.
Set up the smith machine with the barbell at shoulder height.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
Step under the bar and position it across your upper back, resting on your traps.
Grip the bar with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the bar and take a step back, maintaining a stable stance.
Keeping your chest up and core engaged, initiate the squat by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Lower your body until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as your flexibility allows.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then drive through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.exerciseName: weighted floor crunch feet on bench

instructions.originalText: Lie on your back with your calves on a bench and knees bent.
Hold a weight plate or dumbbell against your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor by tightening your abs.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.exerciseName: weighted floor twisting crunch feet on bench

instructions.originalText: Lie on your back with your calves on a bench and knees bent.
Hold a light weight against your chest with both hands.
Curl up and rotate one shoulder toward the opposite knee.
Lower with control.
Alternate sides each rep.
Start by hanging from a pull-up bar with your palms facing away from you and your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and pull your body up towards the bar, leading with your chest.
As you reach the top of the movement, transition your grip so that your palms are facing towards you.
Continue pulling yourself up until your chest reaches the bar, then pause for a moment.
Slowly lower yourself back down to the starting position, maintaining control throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Sit on the edge of a bench or chair with your hands gripping the edge next to your hips.
Slide your hips forward off the bench and straighten your legs, keeping your heels on the ground.
Bend your elbows and lower your body towards the ground, keeping your back close to the bench.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your hands to straighten your arms and lift your body back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Position yourself between two parallel bars with your arms extended and supporting your body weight.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Position yourself between two parallel bars with your arms fully extended and your body suspended in the air.
Bend your knees and cross your ankles.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Hang from a bar with one hand and hold a light dumbbell in the other hand at your side.
Brace your core and pull your shoulder down.
Pull yourself up with the hanging arm until your chin reaches the bar.
Lower slowly to a straight arm.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.
Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended overhead.
Bend your knees slightly and engage your core.
Lower your body down into a squat position while keeping your arms extended overhead.
As you squat down, press your arms down towards the ground, engaging your triceps.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the squat, then push through your heels to stand back up while simultaneously raising your arms back overhead.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Place your hands on your hips or cross them in front of your chest.
Keeping your back straight, slowly bend forward at the waist, lowering your upper body towards the ground.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly raise your upper body back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Start by hanging from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and pull your shoulder blades down and back.
As you pull yourself up, bend one arm and bring your elbow towards your side, while keeping the other arm straight.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar and your bent arm is fully flexed.
Lower yourself back down with control, straightening the bent arm and repeating the movement on the other side.
Alternate sides with each repetition.
Start in a push-up position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Extend one arm straight out to the side, parallel to the ground.
Lower your body by bending your elbows, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
Push back up to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side, extending the opposite arm out to the side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
Hang from a bar with an overhand grip, shoulder-width apart.
Lift your body into a front lever: straight and level with the floor, arms straight.
Keep your body level and pull the bar toward your hips by bending your elbows.
Lower slowly back to straight arms without dropping your hips.
Lower your legs to rest between sets.
Start by hanging from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and pull your shoulder blades down and back.
Bend your knees and tuck them towards your chest.
Simultaneously, lift your legs up and extend them straight out in front of you, keeping your body parallel to the ground.
Hold this position for as long as you can, aiming for a full front lever position.
To release, slowly lower your legs back down and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Start by hanging from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and pull your shoulder blades down and back.
Bend your knees and tuck them towards your chest.
Slowly lift your legs up, keeping them straight, until your body is parallel to the ground.
Hold this position for a few seconds, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Lock your elbows and lean your shoulders forward past your hands.
Lift your feet off the floor and spread your legs wide.
Hold your body level with the floor, arms straight and core and glutes tight.
Hold for a few seconds, then lower your feet with control.
Start in a push-up position with your hands shoulder-width apart and your fingers pointing forward.
Engage your core and slowly shift your weight forward, lifting your feet off the ground.
Continue shifting your weight forward until your body is parallel to the ground, balancing on your hands.
Hold this position for as long as you can, maintaining a straight body line.
Slowly lower your feet back to the ground and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Start in a push-up position with your hands shoulder-width apart and your body straight.
Engage your core and slowly shift your weight forward, bringing your shoulders past your hands.
Keep your elbows slightly bent and your body straight as you lean forward.
Hold this position for a few seconds, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Start in a push-up position with your hands shoulder-width apart and your feet together.
Bend your elbows and lower your body towards the ground, keeping your back straight.
As you lower your body, lift your feet off the ground and bring your knees towards your chest.
Hold this position for a few seconds, then extend your legs back out and push yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Find an open space with enough room to perform a handstand.
Place your hands on the ground shoulder-width apart, fingers pointing forward.
Kick your legs up towards the wall, using your core and shoulders to maintain balance.
Once in a handstand position, engage your triceps to support your body weight.
Hold the handstand for as long as you can maintain balance.
To come down, slowly lower your legs back to the ground.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Start by gripping a vertical pole with both hands, palms facing each other, and arms fully extended.
Engage your core and lift your legs off the ground, keeping them straight.
Using your core and upper body strength, raise your legs until they are parallel to the ground.
Hold this position for as long as you can, maintaining a straight body line.
Slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Start by hanging from a bar with your arms fully extended and your body relaxed.
Engage your core and lift your legs up, bringing your knees towards your chest.
Continue to lift your legs up and over your head, allowing your body to pass through the arms.
Once your legs are fully extended over your head, begin to lower them back down towards the starting position.
As you lower your legs, allow your body to pass back through the arms until you are hanging with your arms fully extended again.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell at shoulder height with an overhand grip.
Lower into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
As you reach the bottom of the squat, explosively drive through your heels to stand up, simultaneously pressing the barbell overhead.
Lower the barbell back to shoulder height as you lower back into the squat position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Set up the implement in front of you.
Grip it firmly with both hands.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Lift it using your legs and hips.
Hold it steady for a moment.
Lower it under control.
Stand with feet wide and the keg between your legs, gripping it low with both hands.
Hinge at the hips, keep your chest up and your back flat.
Drive your hips forward hard and pull the keg up your body.
Extend fully and throw the keg up and back over the bar.
Reset, step back to the start and repeat with control.
Stand with feet hip width apart and the bar over your mid foot.
Hinge down, grip the bar just outside your legs and brace your core.
Push the floor away and keep the bar close as you stand up.
Lock out with hips and knees extended and shoulders back.

Step in, rest the bar on your front shoulders with elbows high.
Lift it off and stand tall with feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down with a tall chest until your thighs pass parallel.
Stand back up by driving through your feet, then re-rack the bar.
Start by hanging from a pull-up bar with your palms facing away from you and your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and pull your shoulder blades down and back.
Bend your elbows and pull your chest towards the bar, keeping your body straight.
Once your chest reaches the bar, push down with your hands and drive your elbows back, lifting your body above the bar.
Pause at the top of the movement, then slowly lower yourself back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Position yourself between parallel bars with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Start by hanging from a pair of rings with your arms fully extended and your body in a straight line.
Spread your legs wide apart, forming a straddle position.
Engage your core and slowly lower your body until your arms are parallel to the ground.
Hold this position for a few seconds, then push yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Finish all lifts for one round, then lower the bar and rest before repeating.

Brace your core and pull your chest up.

Engage your core and swing your arms in a circular motion, rotating your torso as you do so.
