Keep your core tight and elbows close.
Press back up to straight arms.
Set the pulleys at chest height and grab the handles.
Step forward with a staggered stance and a slight elbow bend.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest.
Squeeze your pecs for a moment.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch.

exercises.exerciseName: overhead sit up with legs on bench

instructions.originalText: Lie on your back with your calves resting on a bench, knees bent.
Extend your arms overhead.
Curl your torso up, keeping your arms by your ears.
Reach toward your knees.
Lower slowly.
Lie on your back with your knees bent, one foot forward of the other.
Press through both heels to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Keep your hips level.
Lower slowly.
Switch the foot position halfway through.
Lie on your back with your legs straight and your heels on the floor.
Press your heels down and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Keep your ribs down.
Lower slowly.
Repeat for the planned reps.

exercises.exerciseName: dumbbell standing front and lateral raise

instructions.originalText: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides.
Raise both arms to the front up to shoulder height.
Lower them back down.
Raise them out to your sides to shoulder height.
Lower with control and repeat.
Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend.
Hop sideways a short distance.
Land softly on the same foot and hold your balance.
Hop back the other way.
Complete reps, then switch legs.
Start in a high plank, hands under shoulders.
Drive one knee toward the outside of your elbow.
Return that foot and switch legs.
Keep your hips low and your core braced.
Move at a quick, controlled pace.

exercises.exerciseName: dumbbell goblet squat with calf raise

instructions.originalText: Hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up to standing.
Rise onto your toes at the top.
Lower your heels and go into the next squat.

exercises.exerciseName: double plank jack to 4 mountain climber

instructions.originalText: Start in a high plank.
Jump your feet wide and together twice.
Do four mountain climbers, driving your knees alternately.
Keep your hips level.
Flow through the sequence at a steady pace.
Hang from rings with a wide grip.
Pull up toward one hand, leaving the other arm straight.
Reach the top with your chin by that hand.
Lower under control.
Alternate sides each rep.
Hang from one ring with a firm grip.
Brace your core and keep your legs together.
Pull your chin up toward the ring.
Lower with control to a full hang.
Complete reps, then switch arms.
Lie on your back with knees bent and arms in a goalpost position.
Keep your back and wrists on the floor.
Slide your arms up overhead.
Return slowly to the start.
Move within your comfortable range.
Stand tall with your feet together.
Hop forward a short distance on the balls of your feet.
Hop back to the start.
Land softly with your knees slightly bent.
Keep a quick tempo.
Repeat for the planned time.
Stand with feet wide and toes out, holding a dumbbell at your chest.
Keep your chest up.
Squat down between your legs.
Keep your knees pointing over your toes.
Drive up and squeeze your glutes.
Swing the kettlebell up to chest height from a hip hinge.
Catch it at your chest in a goblet hold.
Sit into a deep squat.
Stand up and lower the bell back between your legs.
Hinge and swing again.
Place your rear foot on a bench and hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Step the front foot forward.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso tall.
Push through the front heel and switch legs after your reps.

exercises.exerciseName: dumbbell bulgarian split squat from deficit

instructions.originalText: Stand with your front foot on a low platform and your rear foot on a bench.
Hold dumbbells at your sides.
Lower until your back knee is near the floor.
Keep your front knee steady.
Drive up and switch legs.

exercises.exerciseName: bodyweight heel elevated bulgarian split squat

instructions.originalText: Place your rear foot on a bench and front heel on a small plate.
Hold your hands at your chest.
Lower straight down.
Keep your front knee over your toes.
Push up and switch legs.
Rest the barbell in the crooks of your elbows.
Put your rear foot on a bench.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your chest up.
Drive up and switch legs.
Stand in a doorway with forearms on the frame, elbows at 90 degrees.
Step one foot forward.
Lean gently through the door until you feel a stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Breathe slowly and step back.

exercises.exerciseName: parallel bars bent knee inverted row

instructions.originalText: Lie under parallel bars and grab them.
Bend your knees with feet on the floor.
Keep your body straight from shoulders to knees.
Pull your chest to the bars.
Lower slowly.
Stand tall with arms at your sides.
Jump your feet out and raise your arms overhead.
Jump back in and bring one knee high.
Alternate knees each rep.
Stay light on your feet.
Start in a squat with hands at your chest.
Jump your feet out wide.
Hop back to the narrow squat stance.
Stay low the whole time.
Land softly and keep your chest up.
Lean your back on a wall with feet close together.
Slide down until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep knees over ankles.
Hold for 20-60 seconds.
Slide back up slowly.
Stand with your heels on a low platform and your back on a wall.
Slide down until thighs are parallel.
Keep your back flat.
Hold for 20-45 seconds.
Slide up carefully.
Hold a dumbbell at your chest and lean on a wall.
Slide down until thighs are parallel.
Keep your knees above your ankles.
Hold for 20-45 seconds.
Stand up slowly.
Stand on one leg with the other lifted in front.
Extend your arms for balance.
Lower down with control.
Keep your knee over your toes.
Push up and switch legs.

exercises.exerciseName: bodyweight single leg squat with support

instructions.originalText: Hold a stable support with one hand.
Stand on one leg with the other lifted.
Lower down as far as you can with control.
Use the support only as much as needed.
Push up and switch legs.
Sit sideways on a bench or chair edge.
Bend one knee, tucking your foot behind you.
Hold your ankle and gently pull it toward your glutes.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

exercises.exerciseName: kettlebell swing clean grip front squat

instructions.originalText: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and the kettlebell on the floor in front of you.
Hinge back and swing the bell between your legs.
Drive your hips forward to swing, catching it in a clean position at your chest.
Squat down with your chest tall.
Stand back up and lower the bell to swing again.
Keep your back flat throughout.

exercises.exerciseName: cable split stance single arm row

instructions.originalText: Stand in a split stance facing a low cable.
Grab the handle with one hand.
Row to your hip, squeezing the shoulder blade.
Keep your torso steady.
Return slowly and switch sides.
Lie on a bench holding a barbell above your chest.
Keep a slight elbow bend.
Lower the bar behind your head.
Pull it back over your chest.
Keep your ribs down.
Hold dumbbells behind you with your heels slightly raised.
Keep your chest up.
Squat down.
Stay tall.
Drive up through your feet.
Stand with your heels on a small plate.
Extend your arms in front.
Squat deep with your chest up.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Stand back up.

exercises.exerciseName: cable front squat with v bar

instructions.originalText: Hold a V bar at chest height.
Stand a step back from the cable.
Squat down with your elbows up.
Keep your chest tall.
Stand up.
Hold a kettlebell in one hand.
Step back with the opposite leg.
Lower until the back knee nears the floor.
Push through the front foot.
Finish reps and switch sides.
Hold a kettlebell in one hand.
Step back with the leg on the same side.
Lower under control.
Keep your torso upright.
Push back up and switch sides.
Sit at the lat pulldown station, thighs secured, and grab the neutral-grip handle.
Lean back slightly and brace your core.
Pull the handle down to your upper chest, driving your elbows toward your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the bottom.
Let the handle rise slowly until your arms are fully extended.

exercises.exerciseName: cable kneeling high low anti rotation chop

instructions.originalText: Kneel side-on to a high cable and hold the handle with both hands.
Brace your core and keep your hips square.
Chop the handle diagonally down across your body, arms mostly straight.
Do not let your torso rotate; the arms and shoulders do the travel.
Return slowly under control, finish your reps, then switch sides.
Lie on your back with your knees bent and arms extended.
Lift your shoulders and legs off the floor.
Twist your torso and bring your knees toward one side.
Turn back through the centre and lift again.
Repeat to the other side, keeping the movement smooth and controlled.

exercises.exerciseName: cable ipsilateral glute dominant step up

instructions.originalText: Stand in front of a box with a cable handle in the hand on your working side.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Lean your torso forward slightly.
Drive through the heel to stand up.
Lower slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

exercises.exerciseName: cable single arm high row with chest support

instructions.originalText: Set a handle on a high pulley and lean your chest against the support.
Grab the handle with one hand and let your arm extend.
Pull your elbow back and down toward your hip.
Squeeze your shoulder blade at the end of the pull.
Return slowly to full extension, finish your reps, then switch arms.
Stand tall holding a weight plate with both hands at your thighs.
Raise it straight in front of you to shoulder height.
Keep your arms nearly straight and your ribs down.
Hold the position, breathing steadily, for 20-40 seconds.
Lower the plate slowly with control.
Attach an ankle cuff to a low cable and kneel on hands and knees facing it.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Kick the cuffed leg back and up.
Squeeze at the top.
Return slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

exercises.exerciseName: dumbbell glute dominant bulgarian split squat

instructions.originalText: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand with your back foot on a bench.
Step the front foot out far enough for your shin to stay near vertical.
Lean your torso forward slightly.
Lower until the thigh is parallel.
Drive through your front heel to rise.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
Lie on your back with the cable set low behind your head and hold the rope ends.
Start with your arms extended.
Pull the rope toward your face, elbows flaring out and wide.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Return slowly to the start.

exercises.exerciseName: cable incline rear delt fly with back support

instructions.originalText: Lie chest down on an incline bench between two cable stations.
Grab the opposite handles, arms hanging with a slight bend.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder level.
Pause and squeeze your rear delts.
Lower slowly without swinging.
Sit in the sled and place your feet high and wide on the platform.
Release the safety and lower the sled until your knees reach about 90 degrees.
Keep your lower back pressed into the seat.
Push through your heels to extend your legs without locking the knees.
Lower under control for each rep.

exercises.exerciseName: cable high row with chest support

instructions.originalText: Set the cable high and lean your chest against the support pad.
Grab the handles and extend your arms.
Pull your elbows back and slightly down.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Let your arms extend slowly to the start.

exercises.exerciseName: dumbbell contralateral glute dominant bulgarian split squat

instructions.originalText: Hold one dumbbell in the hand opposite your front leg.
Put your back foot on a bench and step the front foot forward.
Lean your torso forward slightly.
Lower until the front thigh is parallel.
Drive up through the front heel.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down, place your hands on the floor and jump your feet back to a plank.
Lower your chest to the floor and push up, or skip the push-up if you prefer.
Jump your feet back toward your hands.
Jump up, spreading your arms and legs like a jumping jack, then repeat.
Set bands on the bar and lie on a flat bench with your feet planted.
Unrack the bar over your chest with a firm grip.
Lower it to your mid chest under control.
Press up and out until your arms are straight.
Keep your shoulder blades pinched and your feet down.

exercises.exerciseName: barbell pin bench press conventional grip

instructions.originalText: Set the pins at a height just above your chest and lie on the bench.
Grab the bar at about shoulder-width plus a little.
Pause the bar on the pins to remove momentum.
Press the bar straight up until your arms lock out.
Lower back to the pins with control and reset for each rep.

exercises.exerciseName: lying single leg hamstring stretch against wall

instructions.originalText: Lie on your back with your hips close to a wall.
Rest one heel on the wall with your leg as straight as feels comfortable.
Keep the other leg flat on the floor.
Relax and breathe, letting the hamstring lengthen.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

exercises.exerciseName: single arm lat stretch against wall

instructions.originalText: Stand beside a wall and place one hand on it above head height.
Step your feet back slightly.
Press your hips away and lean your chest down toward the floor.
Feel the stretch along your side and under the armpit.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.

exercises.exerciseName: flying lizard yoga pose utthan pristhasana

instructions.originalText: Start in a low lunge with your front foot between your hands.
Lower your forearms to the floor or blocks.
Drop your back knee or keep it lifted.
Let your hips sink.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Step back and switch sides.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Curl the weights up toward your shoulders, elbows fixed.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Hold the end of the landmine bar against your chest with both hands.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips down and back, keeping your chest tall.
Squat until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Drive through your whole foot to stand back up.
Hold the end of the landmine bar at your shoulder.
Step one foot back into a lunge.
As you rise, press the bar overhead.
Lower the bar to your shoulder while you lunge back again.
Complete your reps and switch legs.

exercises.exerciseName: dumbbell ipsilateral single leg stiff leg deadlift

instructions.originalText: Hold a dumbbell in the hand on the same side as your standing leg.
Shift your weight to that leg with a soft knee.
Hinge at the hips and reach the weight toward the floor.
Extend the other leg straight behind you.
Return to standing by squeezing your glute.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

exercises.exerciseName: sitting alternate knee to elbow twist

instructions.originalText: Sit tall on the floor, leaning back slightly with your hands behind your head.
Lift your feet off the floor.
Twist and bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Return to centre and repeat on the other side.
Alternate sides at a steady pace.
Set a rope at head height and half kneel facing the stack.
Hold the rope ends with your palms facing in.
Pull the rope toward your face, elbows high and wide.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly. Switch the leading knee after your set.

exercises.exerciseName: cable standing supinated face pull (with rope)

instructions.originalText: Set the rope at face height and grip it with your palms facing up.
Step back and stand tall.
Pull the rope toward your face, elbows leading.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the end.
Return slowly to the start.
Loop a towel around a sturdy anchor and hold both ends, palms up.
Lean back with your arms extended.
Pull your hands toward your face, elbows wide.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower yourself slowly. Walk your feet in to make it harder.
Kneel on a pad with your ankles held down firmly.
Keep your body straight from knees to head.
Lower forward as slowly as you can.
Catch yourself with your hands at the bottom.
Push back up and repeat.
Lie face down on a bench or the floor with a light dumbbell in each hand.
Bend your elbows to about 90 degrees.
Lift your arms out and up into a W shape.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.exerciseName: kettlebell swing clean grip front squat v. 2

instructions.originalText: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and the kettlebell on the floor in front of you.
Hinge back and swing the bell between your legs.
Drive your hips forward to swing, catching it in a clean position at your chest.
Squat down with your chest tall.
Stand back up and lower the bell to swing again.
Keep your back flat throughout.
Lie on your back with arms straight above you and knees bent at 90 degrees.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lower one arm and the opposite leg toward the floor.
Return to the start.
Alternate sides with a slow tempo.
Keep your ribs down.
Lie on your back and lift your hips slightly with hands under your glutes.
Raise your legs.
Pedal backward in a smooth circle.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Continue for a set time or reps.

exercises.exerciseName: side plank twist arm delt raise

instructions.originalText: Set up in a side plank on your forearm.
Raise your top arm up toward the ceiling.
Rotate and thread your arm under your torso.
Open back up and raise the arm again.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.
Start in a high plank, hands under shoulders.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Move quickly, hopping or shifting your hands and feet.
Keep your hips level and avoid sagging.
Rest when your form slips.
Adjust the seat and sit with your back supported.
Grip the handles overhead with your elbows pointing up.
Extend your arms until they are almost straight.
Squeeze your triceps at the top.
Lower slowly behind your head.
Lie chest down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Pin your upper arms to your sides.
Straighten your elbows to kick the weights back.
Squeeze your triceps.
Return slowly.
Keep your upper arms still.
Kneel beside a bench with one hand and the same-side knee on it.
Hold a dumbbell in the free hand with your upper arm against your side.
Extend your elbow to kick the weight back.
Squeeze your triceps.
Lower slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
Stand with a weight plate held at your chest, elbows bent.
Brace your abs and bend your knees slightly.
Push the plate out explosively with both arms.
Fully extend your arms.
Pull the plate back to your chest with control.
Repeat for the planned reps.
Load one end of the barbell in a landmine and stand facing it, feet hip-width.
Hinge back and grip the bar end with both hands.
Brace your abs and keep your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand.
Lower the bar under control.
Repeat for the planned reps.
Place your hands on towels on the floor in a plank.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up.
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees.
Repeat for the planned reps.
Sit on a bench with back support, holding one dumbbell overhead with both hands.
Keep your upper arms close to your head.
Lower the weight behind your head by bending your elbows.
Extend your arms back up.
Keep your core tight.
Repeat for the planned reps.

exercises.exerciseName: kneeling rotation torso rear fly to thread through

instructions.originalText: Start on hands and knees.
Place one hand behind your head and rotate your torso open, elbow to the ceiling.
Return and thread that arm under your chest.
Let your shoulder reach toward the floor.
Keep your hips still.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
Sit facing a low cable and hold the handle with one hand.
Rest your elbow near your side.
Curl the handle up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly and switch arms after your set.

exercises.exerciseName: cable seated single arm unilateral bicep curl

instructions.originalText: Sit upright with a low cable handle in one hand.
Keep your elbow tucked in.
Curl up toward your shoulder without leaning back.
Squeeze at the top for a second.
Lower under control, then switch arms.
Lie on your back holding dumbbells at chest level, knees bent.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Press the dumbbells up over your chest.
Lower with control while holding your hips high.
Finish your reps, then lower your hips.
Hold a light dumbbell in each hand and hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Let your arms hang below your shoulders, palms facing each other.
Raise both arms forward and up at about 45 degrees to form a Y.
Pause briefly at the top and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower the weights slowly under control.
Keep your neck long and avoid swinging your torso.

exercises.exerciseName: resistance band 45 degree hip extension glute focused

instructions.originalText: Set up on a 45 degree hip extension bench with the band anchored under your feet and held across your upper back.
Cross your arms or hold the band at your shoulders.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back until you feel your hamstrings stretch.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes to come back up.
Stop when your body is in a straight line.
Do not over-arch your lower back at the top.

exercises.exerciseName: resistance band wide stance anti rotation chop

instructions.originalText: Anchor the band at one side and stand sideways with your feet wide.
Hold the handle with both hands.
Brace your core.
Press or chop diagonally while keeping your torso square.
Return slowly. Switch sides after your set.
Hold a kettlebell with both hands and stand with your feet wide.
Start with it high beside one shoulder.
Rotate and chop down to the opposite knee.
Pivot your back foot as you turn.
Return with control and switch sides.
Kneel on all fours with your hands under your shoulders.
Place one hand behind your head.
Rotate your upper body and point that elbow toward the ceiling.
Follow your elbow with your eyes and keep your hips square.
Return and touch the elbow toward the opposite arm.
Do your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.exerciseName: dumbbell single leg hip thrust v. 2

instructions.originalText: Sit with your upper back against a bench and a dumbbell on your hips.
Plant one foot and lift the other leg.
Drive your hips up until your body is straight.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.
Have a partner place a plate on your upper back, or set it carefully yourself.
Get into a high plank.
Lower your chest to the floor, elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Attach an ankle cuff to a low cable pulley and strap it to one ankle.
Face the machine and hold the frame for balance.
Keep your leg straight and kick it back and slightly out to the side.
Squeeze your glute at the top without leaning forward.
Return slowly without letting the weight stack touch down.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
Sit with your legs apart and hold a weight in one hand.
Rest the back of your upper arm against your inner thigh.
Curl the weight up with help from your other hand if needed.
Lower it very slowly over about 3 to 4 seconds.
Keep your upper arm still against your leg.
Do your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.exerciseName: resistance band standing balance hip abduction

instructions.originalText: Put a band around your ankles and stand on one leg.
Hold something for balance if needed.
Lift the free leg out to the side.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower slowly and switch legs after your set.
Start on all fours with your knees slightly wider than your hips.
Sit your hips back toward your heels and reach your arms forward.
Let your chest sink toward the floor.
Rock forward and back slowly, then walk your hands to each side.
Breathe deeply and relax your neck.
Move gently for 30 to 60 seconds.
Set the pulleys at a high position and grab a handle in each hand.
Step forward with a slight lean.
Bring your hands together in a wide arc.
Squeeze your chest as your hands cross.
Return slowly to a stretch.
Lie on your back and loop a band around your feet, holding the ends.
Bring your knees toward your chest.
Press your feet away until your legs are almost straight.
Control the band as it pulls you back.
Repeat for your reps.

exercises.exerciseName: triceps dip on high parallel bars

instructions.originalText: Grip the bars and lift yourself with straight arms.
Keep your body upright and elbows close.
Lower until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Press back up to straight arms.
Avoid shrugging your shoulders.

exercises.exerciseName: lying pelvic floor relaxation and deep breathing

instructions.originalText: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Rest your hands on your lower belly.
Breathe in slowly through your nose and let your belly rise.
Let your pelvic floor and hips soften as you inhale.
Breathe out slowly through your mouth.
Continue for 1 to 2 minutes at a relaxed pace.
Step into a deep lunge with both hands on the floor.
Hold for a breath and feel the front of the back hip open.
Shift your hips back and straighten the front leg.
Flex your front foot and fold gently over it.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds.
Return to the lunge and switch legs.
Stand tall and hold a wall or chair for balance.
Lift one foot slightly off the floor.
Draw slow circles with your toes.
Do about 10 circles in one direction.
Switch to the other direction.
Change feet and repeat.
Hang from a bar with an underhand grip wider than shoulders.
Brace your core.
Pull until your chin is over the bar.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower slowly to a full hang.
Attach an ankle strap and face away from a low cable.
Hold a support for balance.
Lift your knee in front of you.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly. Switch legs after your set.
Stand with a wide stance, toes turned out, and a dumbbell between your feet.
Hinge down and grab it with both hands.
Keep your chest up and back flat.
Drive through your feet to stand tall.
Lower the weight under control.
Set the cable low and stand side-on to the stack.
Hold the handle with both hands.
Pull it diagonally up across your body.
Pivot your back foot and rotate your torso.
Return slowly. Switch sides after your set.
Lie on your back with your legs extended.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Draw your knees up toward your chest.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly without arching.

exercises.exerciseName: sitting side bend on a chair

instructions.originalText: Sit tall on a chair with feet flat.
Place one hand behind your head.
Bend sideways toward the floor.
Return to upright using your side muscles.
Repeat on the other side.
Sit upright near the edge of a chair.
Lean forward slightly with a flat back.
Reach one arm forward and the other back, then alternate.
Move in a steady rhythm.
Keep your core braced.
Sit tall on a chair and clasp your hands together.
Raise your arms diagonally up to one side.
Chop down across your body to the opposite knee.
Rotate through your torso.
Alternate sides at an easy pace.

exercises.exerciseName: sitting prayer chest squeeze on a chair

instructions.originalText: Sit tall on a chair.
Bring your palms together in front of your chest.
Press your palms firmly into each other.
Hold for 10-15 seconds.
Release and repeat.

exercises.exerciseName: sitting alternate abduction twist on a chair

instructions.originalText: Sit tall near the edge of a chair.
Lift one leg and open it out to the side.
Twist your torso toward that leg.
Return to centre.
Alternate sides.

exercises.exerciseName: sitting russian twist on a chair

instructions.originalText: Sit near the edge of a chair and lean back slightly.
Clasp your hands in front of your chest.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Return to centre and rotate to the other side.
Keep your chest tall.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips back and down as deep as you can.
Keep your heels down and chest up.
Pause at the bottom.
Drive up to standing.
Set up in a plank with your hands on dumbbells.
Brace your core and widen your feet.
Lift one dumbbell out to the side.
Avoid twisting your hips.
Lower and alternate arms.
Set up in a plank with your hands on dumbbells, palms facing forward.
Widen your feet for balance.
Row one dumbbell up to your ribs.
Keep your hips level.
Lower and alternate arms.

exercises.exerciseName: dumbbell renegade row on stability ball

instructions.originalText: Place your feet on a stability ball and your hands on dumbbells.
Brace into a strong plank.
Row one dumbbell up to your ribs.
Keep your hips level.
Lower and alternate arms.
Anchor a band and get into a plank facing it.
Hold the band in one hand.
Row your elbow back to your ribs.
Keep your hips level.
Return slowly and alternate arms.
Start in a plank with a dumbbell in each hand.
Row one dumbbell up.
Place it down and step the hands forward.
Repeat with the other arm.
Keep your hips level.
Lie under a strong table and grip its edge with an underhand grip.
Keep your body straight with heels on the floor.
Pull your chest toward the table by bending the elbows.
Squeeze your biceps.
Lower slowly.
Lie on your side with your knees bent and arms in front of you.
Lift your top arm and open it back like a book.
Let your chest rotate open.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return and switch sides.

exercises.exerciseName: cable straight arm pulldown (with rope attachment)

instructions.originalText: Set a rope on a high pulley and stand facing it.
Hinge forward slightly with arms extended.
Pull the rope down to your thighs.
Spread the rope at the bottom.
Return slowly.

exercises.exerciseName: cable half kneeling single arm row v. 2

instructions.originalText: Half kneel facing the cable with the handle in one hand.
Keep your torso tall.
Row your elbow back past your ribs.

exercises.exerciseName: lying floor negative half dragon flag

Hold for 2 seconds.
Release slowly to a neutral pelvis.
Keep your upper body still and breathe normally.

exercises.exerciseName: cable lying incline side leg raise

instructions.originalText: Lie on your side on an incline surface.
Attach the cuff to your top ankle.
Raise your top leg out to the side.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.
Do your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.exerciseName: cable lying incline single leg kickback

instructions.originalText: Lie on an incline surface with the cuff on one ankle.
Hold the support for stability.
Kick your leg back and up.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.exerciseName: leverage single leg squat on hack squat machine

instructions.originalText: Set your back against the pad and step onto the platform.
Place one foot on the platform and lift the other slightly.
Lower into a squat with control.
Keep your knee tracking over your toes.
Press back up through the working leg.
Do your reps, then switch legs.
Lie on a flat bench and hold a barbell above your chest with a shoulder width grip.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead like a skull crusher.
As it nears your head, let the elbows travel down so the bar moves toward the upper chest.
Press the bar up and slightly back over your shoulders.
Lower again along the same path and repeat.
Use a lighter weight and keep your wrists straight.
Lie face down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand and your arms hanging straight down.
Keep your upper arms vertical and your palms facing forward.
Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are fully extended.
Keep your chest on the pad and avoid swinging.

exercises.exerciseName: barbell banded weighted plate bench press

instructions.originalText: Lie on a bench and make sure the bands and plates are secured on the barbell.
Unrack the bar and hold it over your chest with your arms extended.
Lower the bar to your mid chest under control.
Press it back up, fighting the rising band tension.
Lock out your elbows without losing shoulder position.
Keep your feet planted and shoulder blades pinched together.
Sit upright on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise one arm out to the side until it reaches shoulder height.
Lower it slowly, then raise the other arm.
Keep your torso still and avoid shrugging.
Alternate sides for your reps.
Attach a rope or strap to a loaded sled and grip it with both hands.
Face the sled, hinge slightly and set your feet.
Pull the rope hand over hand while walking backward.
Keep your chest up and your back straight.
Drive through your legs as the sled comes toward you.
Stop when the sled reaches you and reset.
Hold a sandbag against your chest or across your shoulders and stand tall.
Step forward with one leg into a long stride.
Lower until both knees are about 90 degrees with your torso upright.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Repeat with the other leg.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and the bag tight to your body.
Stand tall and cross one leg in front of the other.
Raise the arm on the same side as the back leg overhead.
Reach and lean gently toward the opposite side.
Feel the stretch along your side and abs.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
Lie on your back with both legs straight.
Slowly slide one heel along the floor toward your buttocks.
Bend the knee as far as feels comfortable.
Pause for a second.
Slide the heel back out until the leg is straight.
Repeat for your reps, then switch legs.
Lie on your back with one knee bent and the other leg straight.
Tighten the thigh of the straight leg so the knee is locked.
Lift the leg to the height of your bent knee.
Hold for a moment.
Lower slowly to the floor.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
Lie on your back with your knees bent and your hands on your belly.
Breathe in slowly through your nose.
Feel your belly rise under your hands.
Breathe out slowly through your mouth.
Let your belly lower gently.
Continue for 1 to 2 minutes.
Stand tall holding a stick with both hands at hip level, palms down.
Keep the working arm relaxed and let the other hand lead.
Raise the stick forward and overhead as far as is comfortable.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly back to the start.
Keep your ribs down and avoid arching your back.
Stand with one foot flat on a towel laid on a smooth floor.
Keep your heel down.
Curl your toes to pull the towel toward you.
Release and repeat until the towel is bunched under your foot.
Hold on to a support if you need balance.
Do your reps, then switch feet.
Set the band at a stable anchor and kneel with it around your body or hands.
Keep your hips forward and your body in a straight line from knees to head.
Lean back slowly, keeping your hips extended.
Go as far as you can control.
Use your quads to pull yourself back up.
Keep your core braced and your movement smooth.

exercises.exerciseName: stick assisted standing shoulder internal rotation

instructions.originalText: Stand tall holding a stick behind your back, one hand low and the other high.
Let the lower hand grip the stick as the working arm.
With the top hand, gently pull the stick up so the lower hand rises along your back.
Go until you feel a mild stretch.
Hold for 2 seconds, then release.
Keep your shoulders level, then switch sides.

exercises.exerciseName: standing isometric shoulder internal rotation against wall

instructions.originalText: Stand sideways to a wall with your elbow bent to 90 degrees and tucked at your side.
Place the inside of your fist or forearm against the wall.
Press into the wall as if rotating your arm inward.
Hold the contraction for 5-10 seconds.
Relax and rest briefly.
Keep your elbow at your side, then switch arms.

exercises.exerciseName: ball assisted lying bent knee isometric hip adduction

instructions.originalText: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Place a ball between your knees.
Squeeze the ball with your inner thighs.
Hold for 5 to 10 seconds.
Release slowly.
Repeat for several reps.
Sit with your forearm resting on a table, palm down and wrist at the edge.
Place your other hand on top of the working hand.
Try to lift the hand up while the top hand resists.
Hold for 5-10 seconds with no movement.
Relax slowly.
Repeat, then switch arms.
Loop a light resistance band around your thumb and the base of your fingers.
Rest your hand on a table or your thigh.
Push your thumb out against the band.
Hold the tension for 5-10 seconds without moving.
Release slowly.
Repeat, then switch hands.
Start in a forearm or high plank.
Brace your core.
Lower one knee gently toward the floor.
Return it and switch sides.
Keep your hips level.
Breathe steadily.
